Structures and nonmagical objects in the area are immediately overgrown and ruined, nonmagical bright light in the area becomes dim light as it is blocked from hundreds of angles, and nonmagical fire is snuffed out by a rain that doesn't cease.
You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.

A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. In addition, as a bonus action on your turn, you can do any of the following while you remain in the rainforest for the duration:

items: Extend your senses into the forest to learn the location of every creature in the area. Creatures that are hidden from Divination are immune to this effect.

Direct a vine within the spell's area to lash out at a creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine. Alternatively, you can choose for the creature to instead be {@condition restrained} by the vine until the start of your next turn.

Use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, either pass into another tree within the spell's area or step out of the tree you're in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered.

entries: If you cast this spell over 8 hours, the rainforest fills a 1-mile cube, it gains all of its immediate benefits, and it can't be dispelled except by a wish spell. While within the forest, you can use an action to expend a spell slot of 5th-level or higher and reawaken the forest. For 10 minutes, or until you lose concentration, you gain the benefits of the spell as if you had cast it with a casting time of 1 action.
spell.name: Primordial Rainforest

entries: With a wave of your hand, you force the sky above you to clear and become night, in a radius of 1 mile. Within the spell's area, spells that can be cast only at night (such as create undead) can be cast regardless of time of day.
When you cast this spell, choose one of the following effects. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to choose an effect, selecting the same effect or a different one.

Dreamland. The terrain within the spell's area shapes to your desires. The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to see through the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. A creature who discerns the illusion for what it is, sees it as a vague image superimposed on the terrain. You can end this effect as an action on your turn.

Grim. You imbue false life into a corpse you can see within the spell's area. It rises as a skeleton if you choose a pile of bones, or a zombie if you choose a fleshy corpse. On each of your turns, you can use an action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within the spell's area (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature reverts to a corpse or pile of bones when the spell ends.
Shooting Star. A star streaks across the sky. One creature of your choice who can see the star gains 25 temporary hit points. While the creature has these hit points, it immune to fear.

Slumber. You inflict drowsiness on a creature of your choice within the spell's area. If the target has less than 50 hit points, it fall {@condition unconscious} until the spell ends, it takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake.

Star Storm. Ten stars fall from the sky. Each star hits a creature of your choice within the spell's area. Each star deals {@damage 2d4 + 2} force damage to its target (roll damage for each star separately). The stars all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several. Each time you use this effect, the sky grows darker. After the 10th use, the sky above becomes entirely dark, and you can no longer use this effect.
spell.name: Night Sky

entries: You call upon the fury of Kord as the Giantslayer, drawing upon his war armoury .

Eight large weapons shoot down from the sky at points you choose within range. Each weapon is a 10ft cube, and each must strike a different point, although a big enough creature may be struck by multiple weapons.
A creature struck by one or more weapons must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 20d6} damage type of the weapon on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
spell.name: Remembrance of Swordfall

entries: You transform yourself into a being of pure flame. You retain your size category and general shape, as well as your existing features and abilities, and for the duration you gain the following benefits.
* You glow with an orange light, shedding bright light out to a 30-foot radius and dim light for anadditional 30 feet. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet.
* Whenever a creature moves to within 10 feet of you, starts its turn there, or hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes {@damage 5d10} fire damage.
* You have immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and fire damage.

* You can cast fireball as a 3rd-level spell without expending a spell slot. Whenever you roll fire damage for a spell you cast, roll dice that are one step larger than normal. For example, a spell that normally deals {@damage 8d6} fire damage would deal {@damage 8d8} fire damage instead.
spell.name: Siphon Planar Energy: Plane of Fire

entries: A large workshop from Mechanus springs forth into a 200ft cube at a point you choose. For the duration of the spell, You may choose to use the forge to create constructs.
Choose one of the following options for what you may create.

items: One {@filter construct of challenge rating 8 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&8]|type=construct|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Two {@filter constructs of challenge rating 5 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&5]|type=construct|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Four {@filter constructs of challenge rating 3 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&3]|type=construct|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Eight {@filter constructs of challenge rating 1 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=construct|miscellaneous=!swarm}

entries: The construct(s) have the statistics of the chosen form, though it can have a wide variety of cosmetic alterations, chosen by you when you cast the spell.
When the a construct drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind only fine gray dust.
When constructs are created with this spell, they also gain temporary hit points equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier.

At the end of the duration, the forge blinks back to Mechanus where it channels the energy required to keep the constructs powered. If this spell is cast again, these energy channels are reformed and the existing constructs power down.
spell.name: The Grand Forge of Daedalus

entries: You transform yourself in a being of pure lightning with terrible power. You retain your size category and general shape, as well as your existing features and abilities, and for the duration you gain the following benefits.

You glow with a yellow or blue light (your choice), shedding bright light out to a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet, and can choose to pass through solid objects, although you take {@damage 2d10} force damage if you end your turn inside a solid object.

You have immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You are also immune to lightning damage, and any effect that would deal lightning damage to you instead grants you that many temporary hit points. Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes {@damage 4d12} lightning damage.
You can cast lightning bolt as a 3rd-level spell without expending a spell slot. All your spells and abilities ignore other creatures' resistance to lightning damage.
spell.name: Siphon Planar Energy: Plane of Air
Deep Ethereal Tunnel

components.m: a gemstone formed from the heart of a dying world, worth at least 50,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You channel destructive energy to tear the very fabric of space on a surface you touch, creating a permanent rift 10ft in radius to another plane of existence. While casting this spell, roll an ability check with your spellcasting ability. On a 20 or higher, you can choose the connecting plane. Otherwise, the plane is chosen the randomly or decided by the DM.

spell.name: Delete Fate

components.m: an object tied to the target's soul, worth at least 100,000 gp

entries: You touch a creature and erase it from existence. The target is removed from the fabric of reality, forgotten by all.

spell.name: Plane

components.m: a piece of creation or internal void energy, and a sacrifice of the caster's own life force worth 5 times thier hitpoint maximum, over the course of the period of casting.

entries: The spell creates a new, self-sustaining pocket dimension according to the caster's desires, ranging from a paradise to a fortress. This dimension is accessible only through a portal at a fixed location chosen at the time of casting. The caster can define the laws of physics, creatures, and geography within this dimension. Upon completion, the caster's life force is tied to the existence of this dimension, granting them god-like control within its bounds but also linking their life to its continuity.

spell.name: YEET

components.m: an object or creature that fits the description of the spell

entries: For a brief moment, your entire arm becomes ripped and muscular granting you an abnormal physical strength. Immediately afterwards you grab a Tiny object or creature within 5ft of you. An unwilling creature can resist the grab on a successful Strength save against your Spell Save DC. If you have grabbed an object or a creature, you can then throw it at another creature within 60ft of you by making a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, both the object(only if it is non-magical) or creature thrown and the creature that is hit take the same {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage. After you make the attack, your arm returns to normal.

This spell's damage and size restriction for the target you can grab increases when you reach 5th level ({@damage 1d6} and Small), 11th level ({@damage 1d8} and Medium), and 17th level ({@damage 1d10} and Large).

spell.name: Synthesize Ink
entries: You transmute gold pieces using strands of the weave to create rare ink worth 100gp, which is sufficient for wizards transcribing spells into their spellbooks without additional cost.

spell.name: Provocateur's Sneer
entries: You utter derisive words at creatures of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you and force them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save they feel compelled to put you down while you remain within line of sight, giving them disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you and also making it impossible for them to willingly move more than 30ft away from you. Affected creatures can repeat the saving throw whenever they take damage from a creature other than you. This effect ends on the creature if you are incapacitated, you die or if the creature is more than 30 feet away from you.
If at least one target fails the saving throw you gain 5 temporary hit points.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the temporary hit points you gain are increased by 5 and the range of the spell is increased by 5ft for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Displacing Maw
entries: Your rib cage opens up violently, trying to devour an enemy in range. The creature must succeed a Strength saving throw or be devoured by the maw formed by your rib bones, taking {@dice 6d8} piercing damage and be regurgitated at a point of your choice on the ground within 10 feet of you. On a success they take half as much damage and are not transported.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Rupture Veins

components.m: a drop of the caster's blood

entries: You attempt to disrupt the source of a creature's vitality within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw and on a failure, it is subjected to one of the following effects based on its nature:

{@b Creatures with Blood:} The target takes {@dice 2d12} Necrotic damage, and for one minute, any hitpoints it regains is halved as its wounds bleed profusely. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, and end this effect on a success.

{@b Creatures without Blood:} The target's speed is reduced by 10ft and it starts oozing magical blood(evaporates when it falls off the creature) from its orifices for 1 minute. Once during this minute, when the creature is targeted by any spell, magical effect, trait, or class feature that requires the target to possess blood, it is considered as possessing blood and is also subjected to the effects. Immediately afterwards, the creature stops magically bleeding and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Vampiric Rush
entries: Shifting briefly into a swarm of bats, you dash forward while injuring others in your path. You move a distance up to twice your walking speed in a straight line 10 feet wide, and you don't provoke opportunity attacks during this movement. Additionally, you're able to move through other creature's spaces, but can't end your movement there.

Each creature whose space you move through must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d4} Piercing damage on a failed save, and half as much on a successful one. At the end of your movement, if atleast one creature fails the saving throw against this spell, you regain 10 hitpoints.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 2d4} and the hitpoints you can regain increases by 5 for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Waterproof Object

components.m: an object that fits the spell's description

entries: When you cast this spell, target one object that is no larger than 5 foot in any dimension. The spell causes the object to become completely impervious to water or similar liquids for the duration of the spell, even if the physical material that the object is made from may contain physical holes or other damage that would normally allow water or similar liquids to pass through unimpeded.
If the object is larger than 5 foot in any dimension, this spell only affects a 5-foot-sided cube of it and can be cast multiple times to fully cover the object.

spell.name: Freedom of the Waves
entries: You conjure a deluge of seawater in a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within range. This water takes the form of a tidal wave, a whirlpool, a waterspout, or another form of your choice. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or take {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}. You can choose a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting modifier (minimum of 1) to automatically succeed on this saving throw.
If you are within the spell's area, as part of the action you use to cast the spell, you can vanish into the deluge and teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within the spell's area.

spell.name: Freedom of the Winds
entries: Wind wraps around your body, tugging at your hair and clothing as your feet lift off the ground. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on ability checks to avoid being {@condition grappled}, and on saving throws against being {@condition restrained} or {@condition paralyzed}.

When you are targeted by a spell or attack while this spell is in effect, you can use a reaction to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If this movement takes you out of range of the triggering spell or attack, you are unaffected by it. This spell then ends when you reappear.

entries.name: Reload
entries: The weapon can be fired a number of times equal to its Reload score before you must spend 1 attack or 1 action to reload. You must have one free hand to reload a firearm.

entries.name: Misfire
entries: Whenever you make an attack roll with a firearm, and the dice roll is equal to or lower than the weapon's Misfire score, the weapon misfires. The attack misses, and the weapon cannot be used again until you spend an action to try and repair it. To repair your firearm, you must make a successful {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB} check (DC equal to 8 + misfire score). If your check fails, the weapon is broken and must be mended out of combat at a quarter of the cost of the firearm. Creatures who use a firearm without being proficient increase the weapon's misfire score by 1.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: All firearms require ammunition to make an attack, and due to their rare nature, ammunition may be near impossible to find or purchase. However, if materials are gathered, you can craft ammunition yourself using your {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB} at half the cost. Each firearm uses its own unique ammunition and is generally sold or crafted in batches listed next to the price.

entries.name: Minor Upgrade
entries: This firearm can hold {@table Minor Upgrades|AspysGuidetoInfinitum|minor upgrades}

entries.name: Major Upgrade
entries: This firearm can hold {@table Major Upgrades|AspysGuidetoInfinitum|Major Upgrades}

entries.name: Mastery: Cleave
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Melee Weapon, Heavy Property}

If you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, you can make an attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon’s damage, but don’t add your ability modifier to that damage, unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

entries.name: Mastery: Graze
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Melee Weapon, Heavy Property}

If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can’t be increased in any way, other than increasing the ability modifier.

entries.name: Light
entries: While you are wielding {@i Light} weapons in both hands, You may, as part of the {@action Attack} action, make an additional attack with the weapon held in the other hand. You can still make this extra attack only once per turn and you don’t add your ability modifier to the damage of this attack, unless that modifier is negative.

entries.name: Two-Handed Throwing
entries: This weapon has the 'Thrown' property. But requires two hands to make a thrown weapon attack. If this weapon also has the 'Versatile' property, treat the damage from this weapon as though from an attack made with two hands.

entries.name: Mastery: Push
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Heavy, Two-Handed, or Versatile Property}
If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you horizontally if it is no more than one size larger than you.

entries.name: Mastery: Sap
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Versatile property or no other properties}
If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Mastery: Slow
entries: {@i Prerequisite: None}

If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If you hit the creature more than once with this property, the Speed reduction doesn’t exceed 10 feet.

entries.name: Mastery: Topple
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Heavy, Reach, or Versatile Property}

If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition prone} condition.

entries.name: Mastery: Vex
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Ammunition, Finesse, or Light Property}
If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Mastery: Tumble
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Melee weapon, Light Property}
If you hit a creature with a melee attack from this weapon and deal damage to the creature, You can move up to 10 feet through the creature's space without spending movement speed.

entries.name: Dire
entries: If any of it's damage dice rolls it's maximum, you may roll it again and add the damage. You may repeat the process for each subsequent die rolled.

entries.name: Unarmed
entries: Attacks with this weapon count as both unarmed and weapon strikes and changes the damage type from bludgeoning to the type mentioned. If you benefit from a feature that improves the damage dice of your unarmed attack, you may choose to use it instead of this weapon's damage dice. While wielding this weapon, you treat the hand as though you are not holding anything in it and you can hold an item in the same hand but you may not use the weapon while doing so.

entries.name: Keen
entries: When you make a critical hit with this weapon, roll an additional weapon damage die.

entries.name: Hybrid Weapon
entries: This weapon can be used to make either ranged or melee attacks. It counts as a ranged or melee weapon only when making the respective attacks. The damage die for the weapon may be different depending on the attack made.

entries.name: Exotic
entries: This item is rare and not readily available during character creation. Though it may be a simple or martial weapon, characters proficient in either do not automatically gain proficiency with this weapon and is instead specially gained through other means.

entries.name: Hefty
entries: You require the Multiattack feature to use this weapon. It takes two attacks or two actions to make a single attack with it. A creature with a Strength score lower than 15 makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

entries.name: Polearm
entries: This weapon counts as a polearm for the purposes of qualifying for the {@feat Polearm Master} feat.

entries.name: Scattershot
entries: When you target a medium or smaller creature with this weapon, Make an attack against all creatures within 5 feet of it at disadvantage. If targeting a larger or bigger creature, roll an additional damage die if the attack hits.

Murderous tendencies begin to seep into the thoughts of the creature that attunes to this weapon. At the end of every 14 non-continuous days that it is attuned to this weapon, it needs to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Failing this saving throw will cause its alignment to shift one step toward evil (good to neutral, neutral to evil). If the creature is already of an evil alignment, its alignment will move one step toward chaotic evil.
entries.name: Lesser Curse of Corruption

entries: Murderous tendencies begin to seep into the thoughts of the creature that attunes to this weapon. At the end of every 7 non-continuous days that it is attuned to this weapon, it needs to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. Failing this saving throw will cause its alignment to shift one step toward evil (good to neutral, neutral to evil). If the creature is already of an evil alignment, its alignment will move one step toward chaotic evil.
entries.name: Curse of Corruption
Arcane Sentinel
entries: You always know the spell {@spell detect magic} and can cast it at double the radius using 1 charge. On using another charge, the spell can sense through the barriers it is blocked by such as 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

entries.name: Artifact Latent Power
entries: This Artifact has a pool of 15 charges to use its magical abilities. At the end of a long rest, roll a {@dice 1d20}. On a 20 you regain all charges and an additional 10(for a total of 25). On a 1, you regain 5 charges. Otherwise you regain {@dice 2d6+3} charges instead. This Artifact has a +12 to attack and a save DC of 20 for any abilities unleashed through it.

entries.name: Divine Arm Latent Power
entries: This Divine Arm has a pool of 20 charges to use its magical abilities. At the end of a long rest, roll a {@dice 1d20}. On a 19 and up you regain all charges and an additional 10(for a total of 30). On a 1, you regain 5 charges. Otherwise you regain {@dice 3d6+2} charges instead. This Divine Arm has a +14 to attack and a save DC of 22 for any abilities unleashed through it.

entriesTemplate.name: Extended Reach
entries: This weapon adds {{item.reach}} feet to your reach when you attack with it. This property also determines your reach for {@action opportunity attack|PHB|opportunity attacks} with an Extended Reach weapon.

item.name: The Veinblade
entries: This weapon appears as a simple, well-made +1 weapon, but its metal has a thirsty, porous quality. Faint, dark channels run along its surface like blood vessels.

entries.name: Blood Fueled
entries: On your turn, you may stab yourself with the blade with an attack and choose to sacrifice any number of your hit points (minimum 10). This damage cannot be reduced or prevented, These hitpoints are channeled into the weapon and are held there. Any healing you recieve that heals over the sacrificed hitpoints will reduce the charges added to this weapon. You choose which bonuses to lose when you lose charges. For 1 minute, the weapon awakens with the following benefits based on the total HP sacrificed.

items: For every 7 HP sacrificed, the weapon gains a cumulative +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls.
For every 4 HP sacrificed, the weapon deals an additional {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage on each hit.

entries.name: Unlocked Abilities
entries: The total HP sacrificed also unlocks special abilities for the duration:

items: Tier 1 (17+ HP Sacrificed): Blood-Seeker's Leap. As part of the attack used to activate this weapon, you can immediately teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Tier 2 (35+ HP Sacrificed): Sanguine Rupture. As a Bonus Action, you can slam your weapon into the ground, sending out a wave of bloody energy. Each creature in a 30-foot radius must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take necrotic damage equal to your weapon's bonus necrotic damage dice and are knocked prone.
Tier 3 (52+ HP Sacrificed): Executioner's Strike. The first time you hit a creature after activating this ability, you can choose to turn the hit into a critical hit.

Tier 4 (70+ HP Sacrificed): Slaughterhouse Aura. A shimmering, blood-red 20-foot radius aura connects all creatures within it in a psychic network of shared pain. Once a turn, When a creature inside the aura takes damage, creatures of your choice inside the aura take psychic damage equal to half the amount of damage taken by the original creature.

item.name: The Bloodbound Bulwark
entries: This suit of +1 armor is layered with plates that resemble hardened muscle tissue and is cool to the touch. Spikes and rivets on its surface seem designed to draw blood, not just deflect blows.

entries.name: Blood Fueled
entries: As a bonus action on your turn, you can sacrifice any number of your hit points (minimum 10). This damage cannot be reduced or prevented, These hitpoints are channeled into the armor and are held there. Any healing you recieve that heals over the sacrificed hitpoints will reduce the charges added to this armor. You choose which bonuses to lose when you lose charges. For 1 minute, the armor awakens with the following benefits based on the total HP sacrificed.

items: For every 10 HP sacrificed, the armor gains a cumulative +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

For every 2 HP sacrificed, you store 1 hit point at the start of each of your turns including this turn. When you touch a creature, you may choose to tranfer all the stored hitpoints to the creature. This hitpoint store cannot be split.

entries.name: Unlocked Abilities
entries: The total HP sacrificed also unlocks special abilities for the duration:

items: Tier 1 (17+ HP Sacrificed): Retributive Barbs. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you, bloody spikes erupt from your armor, dealing magical piercing damage to the attacker equal to stored hitpoints

Tier 2 (35+ HP Sacrificed): Feast of Resilience. When you reduce a hostile creature with a CR of greater than 5 is reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to absorb its remaining life force. You can choose to roll as many hit dice as your Armor Class bonus from this item. these hit dice are special and are not expended from your hit die pool. If you have multiple types of hit dice, choose the die size.

Tier 3 (52+ HP Sacrificed): Bulwark of Life As a Bonus Action or a reaction to an ally taking damage, you can grant all creatures of your choice within 100 feet temporary hit points equal your hitpoint store.

Tier 4 (70+ HP Sacrificed): Shared Suffering. You become resistant to a damage type of your choosing. Additionally, whenever you take that damage, the creature that dealt it takes the same amount of damage.

item.name: The Sanguine Ciphers
entries: These appear as a set of five scrolls made of pristine, almost translucent vellum dripping in the blood of the Gore forge each held in a case carved from polished bone. The parchment is blank and cool to the touch, but it thirsts for arcane potential. These scrolls function as a +1 spell casting focus.

entries.name: Blood Fueled
entries: When you cast a spell with the Sanguine Cipher as your spellcasting focus, unrolling it and anointing it with your life force. You choose to sacrifice any number of your hit points (minimum 10). This damage cannot be reduced or prevented. These hit points are channeled into the Cipher and are immediately expended to empower the single spell being cast. The following benefits are applied to the spell based on the total HP sacrificed:

items: For every 10 HP sacrificed, you can increase the spell's save DC or its attack roll by a cumulative +1.
For every 20 HP sacrificed, you gain +5 bonus to concentration checks made against this spell
For every 20 HP sacrificed, you gain +2 bonus to ability checks made as a consequence of casting this spell. eg., Dispel Magic and Counter Spell

entries.name: Unlocked Abilities
entries: The total HP sacrificed also unlocks additional effects on the spell

items: Tier 1 (17+ HP Sacrificed): Entropic Spell. Choose a metamagic option available to the Sorcerer Class and apply it to this spell.

Tier 2 (35+ HP Sacrificed): Blooming Spell. You overload the spell with raw energy, causing it to expand beyond its normal confines. You can double the spell's area of effect. For example, a 20-foot radius becomes a 40-foot radius, a 60-foot cone becomes a 120-foot cone
Tier 3 (52+ HP Sacrificed): Maximized Spell. All damage dice for this spell deal their maximum possible value instead of being rolled.
Tier 4 (70+ HP Sacrificed): Limit Break Spell. This spell is cast as if cast from a 10th level slot. No slots are consumed.

item.name: Heart of the Tarrasque
entries: This item appears as a stone-like, dormant organ, roughly the size of a human head, covered in a tough, rocky hide with deep, pulsating crimson fissures. It is impossibly dense and emanates a profound sense of primordial resilience. When implanted, your hitpoint maximum increases by 70. Additionally, if you have not taken damage to your hitpoints since the end of your last turn, you regain as many hitpoints as sacrificed at the start of your current turn. This regeneration does not function if you have 0 hit points.

entries.name: Primal Implantation
entries: This item does not require attunement. To gain its benefits, you must perform a 1-hour ritual where you hold the Heart of the Tarrasque against your chest. At the ritual's conclusion, the Heart magically and painfully burrows into your torso, ejects your original heart, and takes its place, fusing with your circulatory system. The ritual can be performed to reverse the process, but the original heart must be kept preserved.

entries.name: Blood Fueled
entries: As a bonus action, you can command the Heart to flood your body with raw life force. You choose to sacrifice any number of your hit points (minimum 10). This damage cannot be reduced or prevented. These hitpoints are channeled into the heart and are held there. Any healing you recieve that heals over the sacrificed hitpoints will reduce the charges added to this this heart. You choose which bonuses to lose when you lose charges. For 1 minute, the heart awakens with the following benefits based on the total HP sacrificed.

items: For every 5 HP sacrificed, you reduce all incoming damage by +1
For every 20 HP sacrificed, you gain an artificial soul. At the end of your turn, you may remove one condition or effect on you by applying it to the artificial soul, expending it.
For every 10 HP sacrificed, any magical healing you receive/provide restores +5 more hitpoints.

entries.name: Unlocked Abilities
entries: The total HP sacrificed also unlocks special abilities for the duration:

items: Tier 1 (17+ HP Sacrificed): Immovable Mass. You have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone or moved against your will. Your size category increases by one, and your carrying capacity is quadrupled for the duration.
Tier 2 (35+ HP Sacrificed): Unflinching Resilience. Your physical attribute scores increase by +2.
Tier 3 (52+ HP Sacrificed): Adamantine Blood. Your constitution score is doubled for the duration.

Tier 4 (70+ HP Sacrificed): Font of Endless Vitality. For the duration, your very nature defies the logic of magical sacrifice. Any hit points you regain from spells, abilities, or this item's own Regeneration feature can now heal the hit point damage you suffered from sacrificing HP to your other blood-fueled objects. When you heal this "sacrificed" health, the items do not lose their charges.

item.name: Prototype Infernal Blasters
entries: Modelled after the divine pair of pistols wielded by Asmodeus, the Ebony and Ivory, these infernal blasters pack a devilish punch
Wielding these blasters grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and each shot deals an additional {@dice 1d8} fire and cold damage depending on the pistol.

You must hold both the pistols in each hand, otherwise suffering a -10 penalty to attack rolls if used seperately. When you use an extra attack feature to an extra attack, you can use the other pistol to make an additional attack.

entries.name: Infernal Leadfire
entries:
Twice per long rest, you may transform your weapon into a Tommy Gun or a Flamethrower for devastating effect. Upon transforming, roll {@dice 10d10} to determine the total bullet/fuel capacity for this form.

While transformed, when you take the Attack action, you can replace one or more of your attacks with one of the following options based on the chosen form:

In Tommy Gun form, you can unleash a furious hail of bullets upon one or more targets within the weapon’s range. As part of your Attack action, you may expend up to 20 bullets to fire a barrage. Each bullet deals 2 points of piercing damage. Each target must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 20). On a successful save, it takes half damage instead. Alternatively, you can choose to dump the entire magazine shooting all the bullets, transforming it back into the blasters immediately.

In Flamethrower form, you expel gouts of searing flame in a wide arc. As part of your Attack action, you may expend up to 20 units of fuel to create a 60-foot cone of fire originating from you. Each creature within the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 20). A creature takes {@dice 1d8} fire damage per unit of fuel expended on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. For example, if you expend 10 units of fuel, each creature that fails the save suffers {@dice 10d4 fire damage}.
This transformation ends if all bullets/fuel is consumed or one minute has passed.

item.name: Hefty Dread Rot Pot
entries: A massive, rune-carved pot packed with volatile, Dread rot essence. Designed for catastrophic use, these hefty pots are used only by the most fanatical followers of the Dread Prince. Double the standard size, these pots are stuffed with a 2% mixture of Dread rot.
As an action, you can throw the Hefty Rot Pot to a point within 5*Strength Score feet. The pot shatters violently upon impact, releasing a searing cloud of dread miasma in a 60-foot-radius sphere.
Each creature in the area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or immediately become afflicted with Dread Rot.

A creature afflicted by Dread Rot must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. The initial save DC is 20 and increases by 5 for each failure. After three successful saves, the creature recovers and is cured.
Dread Rot Effects:

While afflicted, the creature suffers the following:
A creature cannot regain hitpoints while affected by Dread rot. When the creature takes any hit point damage, it takes additional necrotic damage equal to its challenge rating. Additionally, when the save DC of the disease reaches 100, every further failure reduces the creature's hit dice by 1, and its max hitpoints reduce by 1 roll of the hit dice. If the creature reaches 0 hitpoints or loses all it's hit dice. They turn into a pile of flesh and bones. Only a {@spell true resurrection} or a {@spell wish} spell may revive the creature.
Only a Greater Restoration spell or a Wish spell can end Dread Rot early.

item.name: Dread Rot Grease
entries: This viscous, crimson-black substance was created from the dread rot essence of the 999th layer of the Abyss, Aparhan's domain. Even a small amount is devastating if applied correctly. This grease consists of hardened wax mixed with a 0.5% concentration of this essence.

As a bonus action, you can coat one melee weapon with Dread Rot Grease. The grease lasts for 1 minute. A creature that is subjected to this grease as many times as its constitution modifier before it uses an action to clean it off will be inflicted with the Dread Rot Disease

A creature affected by Dread Rot must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. The initial save DC is 20 and increases by 5 for each failure. After three successful saves, the creature recovers and is cured.
Dread Rot Effects:

While afflicted, the creature suffers the following:
A creature cannot regain hitpoints while affected by Dread rot. When the creature takes any hit point damage, it takes additional necrotic damage equal to its challenge rating. Additionally, when the save DC of the disease reaches 100, every further failure reduces the creature's hit dice by 1, and its max hitpoints reduce by 1 roll of the hit dice. If the creature reaches 0 hitpoints or loses all it's hit dice. They turn into a pile of flesh and bones. Only a {@spell true resurrection} or a {@spell wish} spell may revive the creature.
Only a Greater Restoration spell or a Wish spell can end Dread Rot early.

item.name: +1 Illusionists Cape
entries: These elegant capes shimmer with an ever-changing pattern of colors and shapes, making them mesmerizing to behold. While you wear and are attuned to the Illusionist's Cape, you gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks.

As a bonus action, you can activate the cape to cast {@spell invisibility} on yourself. The invisibility lasts for up to 1 hour or until you attack, cast a spell, or dismiss it as a bonus action. This property can be used once per long rest.
The cape grants you a +1 bonus to your Mesmer spell DC and Spell attacks.

item.name: +2 Illusionists Cape
entries: These elegant capes shimmer with an ever-changing pattern of colors and shapes, making them mesmerizing to behold. While you wear and are attuned to the Illusionist's Cape, you gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks.

As a bonus action, you can activate the cape to cast {@spell invisibility} on yourself. The invisibility lasts for up to 1 hour or until you attack, cast a spell, or dismiss it as a bonus action. This property can be used once per long rest.
The cape grants you a +2 bonus to your Mesmer spell DC and Spell attacks.

item.name: +3 Illusionists Cape
entries: These elegant capes shimmer with an ever-changing pattern of colors and shapes, making them mesmerizing to behold. While you wear and are attuned to the Illusionist's Cape, you gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks.

As a bonus action, you can activate the cape to cast {@spell invisibility} on yourself. The invisibility lasts for up to 1 hour or until you attack, cast a spell, or dismiss it as a bonus action. This property can be used once per long rest.
The cape grants you a +3 bonus to your Mesmer spell DC and Spell attacks.

item.name: Expanded Capacity Shiftweave
entries: This Expanded Capacity Shiftweave is a magical garment capable of storing up to ten different outfits. Instead of having outfits pre-embedded at creation, this shiftweave can absorb and store any non-magical outfit it mimics. By touching an outfit and spending 1 minute concentrating, the wearer can store the outfit's design in one of the shiftweave's available slots. Stored designs can be accessed or replaced at any time.

By speaking a command word as a bonus action, the wearer can transform the shiftweave into any one of the stored outfits. The clothing cannot mimic the magical properties of other magical garments, despite being able to replicate their look.

entries.name: Chameleon
entries: While wearing the shiftweave transformed into a stored outfit, the wearer can choose to also mimic the voice and general mannerisms of the individual typically associated with the outfit. Granting advantage to deception(charisma) checks made to pass off as the individual.

entries.name: Summon Outfit
entries: As an action, the wearer can target one creature they can see within 30 feet and instantly clothe them in one of the outfits stored in the shiftweave, effectively disguising them. This transformation lasts for up to 1 hour or until the wearer dismisses it as a bonus action

item.name: The Stack Overflow
entries: Created in the hidden digital forges of the Technomancers, The Stack Overflow is a sword of sleek, metallic design, with runes of ancient modron etched along its shimmering, spiral blade. When unsheathed, the air crackles with raw data streams, and the faint hum of binary whispers can be heard.

Attacks made with this greatsword gain an additional +3 to attack and damage rolls. Additionally, this blade does {@dice 2d10} damage instead of the weapon's normal damage dice if the target relies on magic or uses enchanted equipment.

entries.name: PixelWorld Failsafe
entries: Within PixelWorld, this blade deals an additional {@dice 2d10} failsafe damage to creations of the system.

entries.name: Codebreaker
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Counterspell} as a 5th-level spell without expending a spell slot. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries.name: Garbage Collection
entries: When the sword strikes an undead or construct, it can instantly disintegrate targets with 64 hit points or less, clearing away the garbage with efficiency.

entries.name: Reboot
entries: Once per long rest, if you fall to 0 hit points, you can choose to 'reboot', instantly regaining 1 hit point and standing up as a burst of energy clears any non-magical restraints or conditions.

item.name: Ring of Salving
entries: You restore an additional {@dice 1d4} hitpoints whenever you heal another creature.

item.name: Smuggler's Ring
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to {@skill Sleight of hand} and {@skill stealth} checks.

item.name: Ring of Geniality
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@skill Persuasion} and {@skill Deception} checks.

item.name: Explorer's ring
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@skill Nature} and {@skill Survival} checks.

item.name: Ring of the mage
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@skill Arcana} and {@skill History} checks.

item.name: Ring of truthfulness
entries: You gain advantage on {@skill Insight} checks.

item.name: Crusher's Ring
entries: Your movement speed is increased by 10ft.

item.name: Ring of Risk
entries: You gain advantage on all attack rolls, but recieve disadvantage on all saving throws.

item.name: Executioner's Ring
entries: When you miss a creature with an attack roll, you can treat that roll as a 20. Once you do so, you cannot use this feature until the next dawn.

item.name: Broodmother's Amulet
entries: If you are healed while wearing this amulet, your attacks deal an additional {@dice 1d6} poison damage until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Moondrop Pendant
entries: You do not provoke opportunity attacks if you are under half your maximum hitpoints.

item.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
entries: When one of your cantrips deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage, you can add your Spellcasting ability modifier to the damage dealt.

item.name: Necklace of Psychic Sparks
entries: Whenever you cast {@spell magic missile}, you shoot an additional dart.

item.name: Fey semblence Amulet
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

item.name: Protector's Amulet
entries: When a nearby ally is targeted by an attack, you can use your reaction to make that attack miss. This feature can only be used once per long rest.

item.name: Boots of Aid and Comfort
entries: You regain 3 hitpoints whenever you heal another creature.

item.name: Bonespike Boots
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and Saving throws while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. Additionally, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition prone}.

item.name: Acrobats Boots
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to Acrobatics checks, and Advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

item.name: Gloves of the Balanced Warrior
entries: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability score modifier to the damage roll of that attack.

item.name: Swordmaster's Gloves
entries: You gain proficiency with the {@item shortsword|tct|Shortsword}, {@item longsword|tct|Longsword} and {@item greatsword|tct|Greatsword}, and have a +1 bonus to attack rolls while wielding these weapons.

item.name: Stalker Gloves
entries: While wearing these gloves, your Sneak attack deals an additional {@dice 1d6} damage. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to Ability checks that use Dexterity.

item.name: Bonespike Gloves
entries: While wearing these gloves, your attacks ignore resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

item.name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
entries: While wearing this robe, you can cast {@spell crusader's mantle}. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until the next dawn.

item.name: Shade-slayer Cloak
entries: If you make an attack roll against a creature unaware of your location, the number you need to roll to land a critical hit is reduced by 1.

item.name: Cap of Curing
entries: When you hand out Bardic Inspiration to an ally, they regain {@dice 1d4} hitpoints.

item.name: Jannath's Hat
entries: While wearing this hate, you have advantage on Charisma {@skill Deception} and Charisma {@skill Persuasion} checks.

item.name: Marksmanship Hat
entries: you gain a +1 bonus to ranged and thrown attack rolls while wearing this hat.

item.name: Hat of the Sharp Caster
entries: When you roll a 1 or 2 on the damage die for a spell attack, you can reroll that damage die. You can only do so once per die.

item.name: +1 Creationist's Goggles
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your artificer spell save DC as well as any DC from a artificer class or subclass.
You learn two additional options for your artificer infusions. The number of infused items you can create is also increased by 1.

item.name: +2 Creationist's Goggles
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your artificer spell save DC as well as any DC from a ranger class or subclass.
You learn two additional options for your artificer infusions. The number of infused items you can create is also increased by 1.

item.name: +3 Creationist's Goggles
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your artificer spell save DC as well as any DC from a ranger class or subclass.
You learn two additional options for your artificer infusions. The number of infused items you can create is also increased by 1.

item.name: +1 Bracers of the Primal Warrior
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your ranger spell save DC as well as any DC from a ranger class or subclass.
You regain two uses of ranger's quarry whenever you finish a short rest, rather than one.

item.name: +2 Bracers of the Primal Warrior
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your ranger spell save DC as well as any DC from a ranger class or subclass.
You regain two uses of ranger's quarry whenever you finish a short rest, rather than one.

item.name: +3 Bracers of the Primal Warrior
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, your ranger spell save DC as well as any DC from a ranger class or subclass.
You regain two uses of ranger's quarry whenever you finish a short rest, rather than one.

item.name: +1 Berserker's Cape
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a barbarian class or subclass.
The maximum amount of wrath die you can hold increases by two.
You regain a use of rage whenever you finish a short rest.

item.name: +2 Berserker's Cape
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a barbarian class or subclass.
The maximum amount of wrath die you can hold increases by two.
You regain a use of rage whenever you finish a short rest.

item.name: +3 Berserker's Cape
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a barbarian class or subclass.
The maximum amount of wrath die you can hold increases by two.
You regain a use of rage whenever you finish a short rest.

item.name: +1 Stalker's Cowl
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, Cunning action DC and any DC from a rogue class or subclass.
Your sneak attack die increase by an additional {@damage 2d6}.

item.name: +2 Stalker's Cowl
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, Cunning action DC and any DC from a rogue class or subclass.
Your sneak attack die increase by an additional {@damage 2d6}.

item.name: +3 Stalker's Cowl
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to weapon mastery save DC, Cunning action DC and any DC from a rogue class or subclass.
Your sneak attack die increase by an additional {@damage 2d6}.

item.name: +1 Pauldrons of the Warrior
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a fighter class or subclass.
While in combat, you can use your action to gain an extra use of action surge. All uses of action surge gained in this way are lost once the combat ends.

item.name: +2 Pauldrons of the Warrior
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a fighter class or subclass.
While in combat, you can use your action to gain an extra use of action surge. All uses of action surge gained in this way are lost once the combat ends.

item.name: +3 Pauldrons of the Warrior
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to weapon mastery save DC and any DC from a fighter class or subclass.
While in combat, you can use your action to gain an extra use of action surge. All uses of action surge gained in this way are lost once the combat ends.

item.name: +1 Shapeshifter Hat
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs of your Druid spells.
While you wear this hat, you can use your Wild Shape feature without expending on of the feature's uses. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: +2 Shapeshifter Hat
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs of your Druid spells.
While you wear this hat, you can use your Wild Shape feature without expending on of the feature's uses. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: +3 Shapeshifter Hat
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs of your Druid spells.
While you wear this hat, you can use your Wild Shape feature without expending on of the feature's uses. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Mizzium Apparatus
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: Innovation is a dangerous pursuit, at least the way the mages of the Izzet League engage in it. As protection against the risk of an experiment going awry, they have developed a device to help channel and control their magic. This apparatus is a collection of leather straps, flexible tubing, glass cylinders, and plates, bracers, and fittings made from a magic-infused metal alloy called mizzium, all assembled into a harness. The item weighs 8 pounds.

While you are wearing the mizzium apparatus, you can use it as an arcane focus. Spells cast through it gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC. In addition, you can attempt to cast a spell that you do not know or have prepared. The spell you choose must be on your class's spell list and of level 5 or lower, and you must provide the spell's components.

You expend a spell slot to cast the spell as normal, but before resolving it you must make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. The DC is 12 + the level of the spell slot you expend to cast the spell. If you succeed on this check, the DC for the arcana check is increased by an amount equal to the spell slot expended until the next dawn.

On a successful check, you cast the spell as normal, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability modifier. On a failed check, you cast a different spell from the one you intended. Randomly determine the spell you cast by rolling on the table for the level of the spell slot you expended.
If you try to cast a cantrip you don't know, the DC for the Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check is 10, and on a failed check, there is no effect.

item.name: Horns of the Berserker
entries: You gain a +{@dice 1d4} bonus to Attack and damage rolls against creatures that are missing any of their hitpoints.
During combat, you take {@dice 1d4} necrotic damage if you don't deal damage during your turn.

item.name: Mask of Soul Perception
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls, Initiative rolls and {@skill perception} checks.
You can cast {@spell detect thoughts} once per day without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Helmet of Grit
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws.

When you drop below half your hit points while wearing this helm, you gain an additional bonus action on your next turn. Once this feature is used, it cannnot be used again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Helm of Balduran
entries: You gain the following bonuses while attuned to this helmet:

items: You gain {@dice 1d4} hitpoints at the start of every turn.
You have a +1 bonus to AC and Saving throws.
You gain immunity to the {@condition stunned} condition.
Any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

item.name: Drow Leather Armor
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your {@skill Stealth} rolls while wearing this armor.

item.name: Ambusher's Armor
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain the following benefits:.

items: You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class.
You gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls.
When you hit a creature with a an attack roll on the first round of combat, you deal an additional 2 points of damage of the weapons damage type.

item.name: Psionic Ward Armor
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
You gain resistance to Psychic damage.
Whenever you succeed on a saving throw from a spell or magical effect, you regain {@dice 1d4} hit points.

item.name: Armor of Persistence
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.

Additionally, the Armor has 5 charges. Whenever you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to expend one charge, gaining resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of their next turn.
The armor regains {@dice 1d4+1} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Shield of Retaliation
entries: If you are hit by a melee attack while wielding this shield, you can use your Reaction to knock them {@condition prone}, unless they succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength/Dexterity modifier).

item.name: Viconia's Walking Fortress
entries: While wielding this shield, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class.

If you are hit by a melee attack while wielding this shield, you can use your Reaction to deal {@dice 2d12} force damage and knock them {@condition prone}, unless they succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, taking only half damage (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength/Dexterity modifier).
You have advantage on saving throws made against spells, and spell attack rolls made against you are made at a disadvantage.
You can cast {@spell warding bond} oncer per long rest.

item.name: Shield of Devotion
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your AC while wielding this shield. Additionally, you can cast the {@spell mass healing word} spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Bonespike Garb
entries: Whenever you enter Rage while attuned to this item, you gain a number of Temporary hitpoints equal to your Barbarian level. Additionally, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take from attacks is reduced by 2.

item.name: Infernal Robe
entries: While wearing this robe, you gain resistance to Fire damage, and a +1 bonus to your armour class. Additionally, you can cast {@spell fire shield} (warm only) once per long rest.

item.name: Cloak of Authority
entries: While wearing this robe, you gain advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Additionally, you have advantage on {@skill Intimidation} and {@skill Insight} checks.

item.name: Robe of Summer
entries: While wearing this robe, you gain resistance to Cold damage.

item.name: Poisoner's Robe
entries: While wearing this robe, any spell you can add {@dice 1d4} Poison damage to one damage roll of a spell you cast that deals Poison damage.

item.name: Icebite Robe
entries: While wearing this robe, you gain resistance to Cold damage. Additionally, you can cast {@spell armor of agathys} as a 4th level spell. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Wavemother's Robe
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and Resistance to Fire and Cold damage while attuned to this Robe. Additionally, you can cast {@spell create or destroy water} without expending a spell slot. Once you do so, you cannot cast it again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: This dagger is uncannily smooth. Arcane symbols are strewn on its hilt. While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. In addition, you can use the dagger as a spellcasting focus for your spells, gaining a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your spells when you do.

item.name: Lance
entries: This weapon loses the Two-Handed property while you are mounted.

item.name: Lancet
entries: It is nearly indistinct from a spear were it not for the plumage that would be the fletching on regular arrows. It can be used as a simple melee weapon which behaves like a {@item javelin|phb|javelin}.

item.name: Shot Pouch
entries: A slighlty brittle pouch coated with black powder, containing shot and gunpowder for use by shotguns.

item.name: Bayonet
entries: A sharp implement usually affixed to some ranged weapons, but still a capable weapon on its own. A ranged weapon with the 'Two-Handed' property (Except for bows) can be turned into a hybrid weapon by attaching a bayonet to it, taking a minute to do so.
After which the ranged weapon gains the following property:-

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries: You use the bayonet to stab dealing {@dice 1d4} piercing damage on a hit.

item.name: Greatbow
entries: A rather large, and wieldy bow usually used by larger creatures. It uses Strength for its attack and damage rolls.
Without a Dexterity score of at least 16, all attacks made with it are at disadvantage.

item.name: Hoopak
entries: A hoopak is a sturdy stick with a sling at one end and a pointed tip at the other.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries: You use the pointed end of the weapon to stab dealing {@dice 1d6} piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Ranged attack
entries: You load a bullet into the sling and launch it with the staff dealing {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

item.name: Whipshot
entries: A whipshot is a combination of a whip and a slingshot.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries: You load a bullet into its sling and whip it {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

entries.name: Ranged attack
entries: You load a bullet into its sling and launch it with a whip crack dealing {@dice 1d8} piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries: You swing it while it's loaded, dealing {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

entries.name: Ranged attack
entries: You lob a loaded bullet from the sling, dealing {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries: You treat it as a {@item quarterstaff|phb|quarterstaff}, dealing {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit or {@dice 1d8} if held with both hands

entries.name: Ranged Attack
entries: You blow out a loaded needle, dealing {@dice 1d1} piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Special
entries: Once loaded, you may replace an attack with a fiery discharge in the form of a a 15 foot cone originating from you. Creatures affected must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC of 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Dexterity Modifier), taking {@damage 2d10} fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. You may rearm the lance by using two {@item shot pouch|tct|shout pouches} and an action.

entries.name: Special
entries: Attacks from this weapon can reach a further 5 feet, making you able to target a creature 15 feet away from you.

entries.name: Special
entries: You wield this weapon as though you are dual wielding it, allowing you to engage in two-weapon fighting (Dual wielder feat and TWF fighting style applies)

item.name: Double Crossbow
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on this turn, you may fire this weapon again using a bonus action, ignoring the loading property for this attack.

entries.name: Special
entries: Attacks with this weapon are at disadvantage unless it is planted onto the ground. Planting requires a bonus action and a surface like dirt or wood that the weapon can dig into. Once planted the weapon is immobile and require a bonus action to displace it. While planted, it deals {@damage 1d4} additional piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Special
entries: A creature hit with this weapon must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition prone}.

item.name: Jester's Dusters
entries: When you make a melee attack with this weapon you choose to deal either slashing, piercing or bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Special
entries: If you attack with a double-bladed scimitar as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make another melee attack with it as part of the same action. This attack deals {@dice 1d4} slashing damage on a hit, instead of {@dice 2d4}.
Elves or Half-Elves who are proficient with this weapon gain +1 AC while wielding it and can treat it as though it has the {@b Finesse} property.

item.name: Hand Catapult
entries: A miniature version of a catapult made for handheld use. It's mechanisms are similar to a crossbow's.

item.name: +1 Kinetic Bracelets
entries: These bracelets are engraved with arcane symbols that faintly glow in response to movement. While you wear and are attuned to the bracelets, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls, spell damage rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Cantrips.
You may also apply this bonus to {@skill Sleight of Hand} and {@skill Performance} checks. In addition, you satisfy the material component of cantrips you cast while they are worn.

item.name: +2 Kinetic Bracelets
entries: These bracelets are engraved with arcane symbols that faintly glow in response to movement. While you wear and are attuned to the bracelets, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls, spell damage rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Cantrips.
You may also apply this bonus to {@skill Sleight of Hand} and {@skill Performance} checks. In addition, you satisfy the material component of cantrips you cast while they are worn.

item.name: +3 Kinetic Bracelets
entries: These bracelets are engraved with arcane symbols that faintly glow in response to movement. While you wear and are attuned to the bracelets, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls, spell damage rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Cantrips.
You may also apply this bonus to {@skill Sleight of Hand} and {@skill Performance} checks. In addition, you satisfy the material component of cantrips you cast while they are worn.

item.name: Lufstalis
entries: The Legendary Scimitar wielded by none other than Geryllen Estfall. It's said to bend the very space around it to land it's attacks
You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon
If you make a critical hit with this weapon, you may disappear and make 2 additional attacks against creatures of your choice within 30 feet reappearing 5 feet near the last creature you attacked.

item.name: The Blade of Disaster
entries: A planar rift bleeds through this hilt made of cold stone.
You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
A roll of 18-20 is a critical hit with this weapon and deals {@damage 12d12} instead of {@damage 8d12} force damage.
This sword can harmlessly pass through any barrier including a {@spell wall of force} stopping at the hilt.

item.name: Sharp Tongue
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
This weapon has 4 charges and it recovers {@dice 1d4} charges at dawn

When a creature that you can see within this weapon's reach makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one charge, attempting to attack it. On a hit, you can roll a {@dice d6|1d6} and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll and dealing that much additional psychic damage. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage.

item.name: Sheath of Gusts
entries: This weapon is nothing but a hilt and a sheath. Once attuned to, removing the hilt from the sheath for a brief moment reveals a blade of concentrated raging winds on it, violently dissipating shortly after.
As part of an attack, you may quickly draw the sword and make one attack after which the blade explodes producing one of the effects as described in the spell {@spell gust|xge|gust} (Save DC 15).
The winds regenerate at the end of the turn while the blade is sheathed.

item.name: Copper Breath
entries: This weapon is nothing but a hilt and a sheath. Once attuned to, removing the hilt from the sheath for a brief moment reveals an acrid smelling blade of foam-like acidic air.

As part of an attack, you may quickly draw the sword and make one attack after which the blade explodes producing the effect of the spell {@spell Pungent Vapours|tct|Pungent Vapours} (Save DC 15) in the place attacked.
The blade regenerate at the end of the turn while the blade is sheathed.

item.name: Gloves of Embers
entries: A pair of soot-blackened gloves
It has 3 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d4 - 1} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 5 and a Save DC of 13
You can expend a charge to cast {@spell produce flame} or {@spell create bonfire}
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, creating a spark like one created by a fire striker.

item.name: Gloves of the Bonfire
entries: A pair of stiff leather gloves. There is a slight smell of sulfur.
It has 5 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d4 + 1} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it, you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 7 and a Save DC of 15.
You can cast {@spell produce flame}, {@spell firebolt} or {@spell create bonfire} at will.
Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can spend one charge to roll an additional damage die.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 1 point of fire damage.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, creating a brief flame.

Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can spend upto 2 charges to roll an additional damage die for each charge spent.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 2 points of fire damage.

As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, creating a small fire in your hand similar to one created by the {@spell continual flame}. It disappears when you wield something in it or fall unconscious or manually with a bonus action.

Snapping your fingers creates a small puff of fog.

You may drop the ball or throw it 60 feet away as an action, disappearing at the start of your next turn.

item.name: Gloves of Storm Steering

When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against you, it takes {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. You may dispel this effect with a bonus action.

item.name: Gloves of Fingersnaps

It has 3 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d4 - 1} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 5 and a Save DC of 13

You can expend a charge to cast {@spell thunderclap|xge} or use it in an action to force creatures in a 10 foot radius around you to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, failing which causes them to be deafened.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, emitting a sound that can heard a 100 feet away.

item.name: Gloves of Whip Crack
entries: A pair of metal gloves. Tapping with it makes it reverberate.
It has 5 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d4 + 1} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it, you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 7 and a Save DC of 15.

Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals thunder damage, you can spend one charge to roll an additional damage die.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 1 point of thunder damage.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, you can have the sound of a whip cracking emit from a point you can see within 60 feet of you.

item.name: Gloves of Thunderstrike
entries: A humming pair of gloves. Earplugs are recommended.
It has 8 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d6 + 2} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it, you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 8 and a Save DC of 16.

You can cast {@spell thunderclap|xge} or {@spell booming blade|tce} at will or an action to force creatures in a 10 foot radius around you to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, failing which causes them to be deafened.

You can cast {@spell thunderwave} by expending 1 charge or {@spell shatter} with 2. You can spend more charges in the casting to add an additional damage die for each charge spent, as long as the total used this turn doesn't exceed 5.
Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals thunder damage, you can spend upto 2 charges to roll an additional damage die for each charge spent.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 2 points of thunder damage.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, causing a sound like distant thunder to reverberate 300 feet around you.

item.name: Gloves of Void Collapse
entries: A thrumming pair of Gloves. You can feel it stirring your bones.
It has 10 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d6 + 4} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it, you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 10 and a Save DC of 18.

You can cast {@spell thunderclap|xge}, {@spell booming blade|tce} or {@spell thunderwave} at will or use an action to force creatures in a 10 foot radius around you to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, failing which causes them to be deafened.

You can cast {@spell shatter} by expending 2 charges, {@spell painful resonance|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} with 3, {@spell thunder step|xge} with 3 or {@spell coulette's concussor|tct} with 4. You can spend more charges in the casting to add an additional damage die for each charge spent, as long as the total used this turn doesn't exceed 7.
Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals thunder damage, you can spend upto 2 charges to roll an additional damage die for each charge spent.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 3 points of thunder damage.
Once on your turn, when a creature takes thunder damage from you, it is pushed 5 feet away.
When you attune to this item you can choose to gain resistance to thunder damage or you may ignore resistance when dealing damage with thunder spells you cast.

As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, causing your arms to reverberate with thunder. When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against you, it takes {@damage 1d6} thunder damage. You may dispel this effect with a bonus action.

item.name: Gloves of Basic Acids

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 5 and a Save DC of 13
You can expend a charge to cast {@spell primal savagery|xge} with your hands or {@spell acid splash|tct}.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, causing the smell of rotting eggs to come from a point you can see with 10 feet of you..

item.name: Gloves of Bitter Study

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 7 and a Save DC of 15.

Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals acid damage, you can spend one charge to roll an additional damage die.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 1 point of acid damage.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, turning a pint of water within 10 feet acidic or cause the air 10 feet around you to become irritable for skin and breathing.

item.name: Gloves of Auric Diffusion

Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals acid damage, you can spend upto 2 charges to roll an additional damage die for each charge spent.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 2 points of acid damage.
As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, causing a sound like distant acid to reverberate 300 feet around you.

item.name: Gloves of the Alkahest

It has 10 charges and replenishes {@dice 1d6 + 4} of them at dawn. While attuned and wearing it, you gain the following benefits:

items: It counts as an arcane focus. Spells cast from the glove have an attack modifier of 10 and a Save DC of 18.

You can cast {@spell Tasha's Caustic Brew|tce} by expending 1 charge, {@spell melf's acid arrow} with 2, {@spell vitriolic sphere} with 4 or {@spell rusting rain|tct} with 5. You can spend more charges in the casting to add an additional damage die for each charge spent, as long as the total used this turn doesn't exceed 7.
Otherwise, when you cast a spell that deals acid damage, you can spend upto 2 charges to roll an additional damage die for each charge spent.
When you make an unarmed strike with this, you deal an additional 3 points of acid damage.
When you attune to this item you can choose to gain resistance to acid damage or you may ignore resistance when dealing damage with acid spells you cast.

As a bonus action you may snap your fingers, causing your arms be coated in viscious veneer of acid. When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against you, it takes {@damage 1d6} acid damage. You may dispel this effect with a bonus action.

item.name: Riviere of Displacement
entries: While you wear this necklace, any spell you cast or effect you produce that causes teleportation has the range of the destination increase by 10 feet for every 30 feet of teleportation range (rounded down).

item.name: Purse of Moneycounting
entries: This item takes the appearance of a regular purse or pouch. It only accepts treasures like jewelry, gems and coins that fits into a hole as wide as a regular hand, harmlessly expelling any other item if it is put into the pouch. The inside of the pouch is much larger than what it appears on the outside, storing up to 10,000 gp worth of coins and treasure.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth, unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again.
You can use a bonus action to shake the bag which will make it produce a set of chimes indicating the value of all the items inside.

item.name: Medallion of Gargoyles
entries: This stone medallion is shaped like a grotesque head. While wearing this item, you can use your action to summon a pair of {@creature Gargoyle|MM|gargoyles} that emerge from a piece of stone that you can see within range. A {@creature gargoyle|MM} summoned by this amulet disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or after 1 hour.

The summoned {@creature Gargoyle|MM|gargoyles} are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for them as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures but otherwise take no actions.
Once the medallion is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: The Memory Crystal
