This heavy crossbow, resembling a T-scale used in architectural design, can be disguised as one. This is not only a weapon but a tool of creation. Its frame is engraved with intricate blueprints and schematics, pulsing with a golden glow.

Wielding this crossbow grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and spell save DC. Thick tungsten bolts magically appear inside the chamber when empty and are superheated on release, dealing an additional {@dice 1d8} fire damage on hit.
At the end of a long rest, choose 5 tools. You gain proficiency in all of them.

entries.name: Soulscope Precision
entries: When you are about to make a ranged attack with this crossbow, expend 5 charges as a spectral scope appears above it, focusing the crossbow's sight to peer into the very essence of an enemy. For a moment, the world fades away, leaving only the target's soul in clear view. This profound insight ensures your next attack against the targeted creature is a critical hit, as you strike with unmatched accuracy at their most vulnerable point.

entries.name: Master Builder's Manifestation
entries: Expend 2 charges as you attack to channel the pinnacle of Daedalus's architectural and crafting prowess. Upon hitting a target or surface, the bolt unleashes a surge of creative energy, manifesting a grand construct of your choice (up to a large size) that persists for 10 minutes. You can have a maximum of two constructs of each type. Choose from the following grand designs upon firing:

items: Fortified Bastion: Erects a sturdy tower of reinforced stone upto 30ft in height, if shot at the base of a creature, the tower erects with the creature still on it. Only one creature can be on top of one tower.
Xbow Turret: Where the bolt stikes, crossbow turret forms out of it. It has a range of 200ft and fires 1 shot at the end of your turn. It uses your attack roll and deals this weapon's damage dice.

Weave deconstructor: Creates a glowing crystal obelisk that unravels the weave and pulls arcane energy from it, sending it outwards creatures of your choice within 20ft of it. At the end of your turns, restore {@dice 1d3} levels of spell slots to a creature within 60ft. The crystal stores the spell slots every round if unused. {@dice 2d3}, {@dice 3d3} for subsequent rounds. Spell slots last on allies for the duration of the crystal.

Compact Ladder: At the point of impact, a ladder 100ft long springs up. The ladder stays still at an incline of your choice, has 1 hp and 10AC. You can have any number of ladders active at any given time.

item.name: (Daedalus) BFG 9000
item.reqAttune: by a creator or follower of Daedalus
entries: The BFG 9000 is a marvel of divine engineering, a weapon that synthesizes the principles of creation and destruction. Forged in the forges of the Plane of Fire, this energy weapon channels radiant energy into concentrated beams capable of slicing through the fabric of reality.
Wielding this weapon grants a +5 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Beams of energy synthesize inside the chamber when this weapon is reloaded.
Each time the BFG 9000 is fired, it recycles a portion of the recoil energy, converting 30% of the attack's damage into temporary hitpoints.

entries.name: Quantum Disruption Blast
entries: Expend 5 charges to fire a concentrated quantum energy projectile. Upon impact, it creates a brief singularity, pulling nearby creatures that fail a strength saving throw within 100ft, 30ft towards the center before detonating in a radius of 30ft, dealing {@dice 6d8} force damage to creatures that failed. All creatures within 15 feet of the impact are then blown 15ft away.

entries.name: Plasma Overdrive
entries: Expend 4 charges to overload the BFG 9000, releasing a wide, sweeping plasma beam. The beam cuts through enemies in a 100-foot line, and a 90 degree arc dealing {@dice 10d8} fire damage to everything in range that fails a Dexterity saving throw. The beam slices through everything that is not wider than 1 feet.

entries.name: Phase Shift Round
entries: Expend 3 charges to charge your next shot with a special wavelength that phases through solid matter. When you make a ranged attack with the BFG 9000, you can target creatures that you do not have line of sight on. The energy beam phases through all matter to reach the target.

item.name: Arrow of Clairvoyance
entries: This arrow gives its user the ability to see or hear an area from the location of the arrow. This field of view is equal to the archer's normal field, and is activated by sounding the command word ("Vision!", or "Listen!") and firing the arrow. The archer is then able to either see or hear the area in front of the arrowhead by closing his eyes and concentrating. Normal restrictions for distance of vision apply with this magical arrow. The duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes.

item.name: Arrow of Faerie Fire
entries: This arrow covers a creature it hits in {@spell faerie fire}.

item.name: Arrow of Explosions
entries: When nocked into a bow, this cursed arrow blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20ft radius sphere centered on the where the arrow strikes must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A creature in the area of the explosion takes {@dice 8d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

item.name: Arrow of Roping
entries: When fired, this magical arrow leaves a smoky brown trail through its entire arc of flight. The trail solidifies into a solid brown rope when the arrow strikes its target, bonding to the bow that fired it. Once bonded, the arrow will never pull free, unless excessive weight is applied. The rope can support up to 500 lbs. of weight at once before it breaks or the arrow pulls free.

item.name: Arrow of Screaming
entries: When this missile is fired, it emits an ear shattering scream that all beings within 30 feet of its flight path must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. Those failing take {@dice 2d6} points of thunder damage and suffer the  {@condition deafened}  condition. In addition, those affected drop everything and cover their ears. Those successful take half damage and are not deafened. At the end a deafened creature's turn, it can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, the condition ends.

item.name: Arrow of Static Discharge
entries: This +2 arrow causes an additional {@dice 6d8} points of lightning damage. When the arrow hits, it discharges all its electricty into the target, causing ripples of static electricty to shock its nervous system. At the start of its next turn, it must roll a {@dice 1d6}. On a 1-3 it is momentarily paralyzed and loses its turn. The arrow is consumed in the lightning charge. If the arrow misses its intended target, it discharges all of its electrical energy upon hitting the ground, or any other solid object.

item.name: Arrow of Returning
entries: Once shot, this +1 arrow will return to the archer's quiver if it misses its target.

item.name: Arrow of Imprisonment
entries: This arrow causes the creature struck to be the target of a {@spell forcecage} spell, centered on them.

item.name: Arrow of Antimagic
entries: This magical arrow has a +2 attack bonus but causes no damage if the target is struck. wherever struck, it creates an antimagic area 20ft in radius and 20ft in height for 10 minutes.

item.name: Ring of Superior Spell Storing
entries: This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 7 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d8 - 1} levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 7th level into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

item.name: Nailgun
entries: This gun has a cartridge that can hold upto 10 nails and is commonly used to nail objects together. You can do so without damaging the objects if you have proficiency with {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}, or another Artisan Tool if the DM allows it. When you shoot and hit a creature with a nail instead, the creature takes {@dice 1d4} piercing damage.
This gun is powered by a gem worth 25gp and the gem provides enough arcane energy for the gun to shoot 50 times before it is completely used up and needs to be replaced.

item.name: Lethal Coin Dispenser
entries: When the Currency Dispensing Outposts (otherwise known as ATMs) were frequently raided by outlaws, the Epalux Multilateral Mercantile Alliance (or EMMA) licensed these firearms to boost their security personnel. The Lethal Coin Dispenser (or LCDs) proved to be an effective countermeasure as the frequency of raids dropped by 74% and the defense failure rate dropped by 97%. However the monetary cost of defenses saw a 36% increase, which was ultimately written off as immaterial expenses by EMMA.

This magical firearm uses coin pieces as ammunition by enchanting them with aerodynamic runes before firing them at the target. The runes lose their potency only after the coin piece hits a target. As a result the coin piece remains intact afterwards but they may be lost instead. If the DM allows it, use the rules for recovering ammunition as stated in the rule, to recover coin pieces you fired using this firearm.
You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Additionally, the damage of the firearm is increased based on the type of coin piece used in the attack as shown below:
When you use {@b Overload Mode}, the weapon can Misfire on a roll of 5 or lower on the {@dice d20}. If the firearm is broken, you must spend 1000 gp over 2 hours to fix it.

item.name: Ring of the Ostentatious Performer
entries: This ring has an ordinary appearance but when worn, the wearer feels a burst of confidence and boldness coursing through themselves. The wearer is immune to the {@condition frightened} condition and gains advantage on all Charisma saves as long as they wear the ring.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that attunes to this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.

Once you wear this ring, TikTok music blasts from your space upto 100ft away and you start dancing. Your speed is halved, your attack rolls and Dexterity saves have disadvantage for the duration. Hostile creatures that see you dancing have disadvantage on attacking creatures other than you.

You then make a DC 35 Performance check at the end of each of your turns. On a failure, any Charisma skill check you make against a creature that can see you dancing is reduced by 10 permanently (this effect cannot be stacked and only affects a creature once). On a success, all creatures that can see you dancing are {@condition Charmed} for one minute or until they take damage, and when the condition ends the creatures know that they were {@condition Charmed} by you.

item.name: Pocket Watch
entries: This pocket watch keeps track of time using intricately designed clockwork components. A creature holding it can see what time it is or deduce how much time has passed from another point in time.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that touches this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.

This pocket watch is always off by anywhere between 10 minutes to 1 hour. However all cursed Pocket Watches show the same time at any moment. It is impossible to discern that the watch is showing the wrong time without another reliable chronological aid.

item.name: Boots of Cushioned Soles
entries: A creature wearing these boots has resistance to any damage it takes from falling and has advantage on saves that inflict {@condition Prone} condition. These boots can be worn by a Medium or Small sized creature and the boots magically reshape themselves to fit the wearer's feet. If the creature's size changes beyond these categories, then the boots slip off of them and fall onto the ground.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that wears this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.
When you enter Stealth, or land on solid surface after a jump or a fall, these boots start making a loud squeaking sound that can be heard upto 180ft away with every step you take.

item.name: Amulet of Faltering Facade
entries: When you wear this amulet, you gain +2 to skill checks using Charisma modifier and any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
Additionally your physical characteristics such as age, gender, physique, skin, hair, and voice change to become extremely attractive without losing their identity while you wear this amulet.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that attunes to this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.

This amulet makes the wearer constantly initiate or involve in conversations and make extremely inappropriate remarks, regardless of the situation. The wearer is oblivious to it and harasses anyone who does not readily agree with their words. The wearer also becomes immediately hostile to any creature that speaks negatively of them.

item.name: Shrieking Whistle
entries: When blown as an {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, the whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 1000 feet away.

Beasts and creatures that have an Intelligence score equal to or less than 5, are {@condition frightened} by the sound and run away from the direction of the source until they are atleast 1000 feet away.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that touches this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.

When you blow this whistle, you and creatures within 120ft must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} for one minute. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, you and creatures within 120ft have disadvantage on Perception and Survival checks for 3 rounds.

item.name: Mirror of Self-Admiration
entries: This mirror is 18 inches by 24 inches in dimensions and it can show reflections even in dim light or non-magical darkness, as if you are seeing it in bright light.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that touches this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.

Any creature cursed by the mirror, that looks into the mirror becomes infatuated with its own reflection. Infatuated creatures are {@condition incapacitated} and {@condition charmed}, until they are snapped out of it by breaking their line of sight with the mirror. Creatures immune to the {@condition charmed} condition are immune to this effect.

item.name: Unraveling Rope
entries: This rope looks exactly like a {@item Rope of Entanglement|XDMG} and the {@spell Identify} spell also considers it as one. This rope also has the same magical properties as a {@item Rope of Entanglement|XDMG} and can be used as one.

entries.name: Curse
entries: A creature that touches this object is cursed and unwilling to part with it until the curse is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic. The cursed property of this object cannot be discerned by any means other than the {@spell Detect Curse|AspysGuidetoInfinitum} spell.
When you tie a knot with this rope or use it to bind something, it always unravels itself at the most inopportune moment, as decided by the DM.

item.name: Featherbed
entries: This luxurious, high-quality bedroll makes you feel incredibly comfortable when you take a rest in it.
You gain the benefits of a Long Rest after just 6 hours, instead of 8.

item.name: Mapping Pen
entries: This is a magic pen whose ink and your own mind are magically bound. As you explore your environment and become aware of the geography of the local area, you can use the pen to make a rough map of the area that you have explored.
The map does not reveal any details of the area that you have not yet discovered.
An 1-ounce bottle of ink provides enough ink for this pen to make a map covering a 15 by 15 area with each tile being a 5ft square.

item.name: Ball of Yarn
entries: This ball contains 300ft (100 yards) of yarn and weighs 0.25 lbs (~100g).
A ball of yarn can be dyed by soaking it in a liquid containing a {@item Coloring Pigment} for 2 hours.
You choose the material of yarn when you buy it.

item.name: Coloring Pigment
entries: The coloring pigment is an 1-inch radius ball of a color you choose when you buy it.
The pigment can color upto 1 liter (~34 fl oz) of liquid in one minute. Once it does so, it cannot color another volume of liquid until an hour has passed by.

item.name: Contact Lenses
entries: These contact lenses give the wearer {@sense darkvision} with a range of 30 ft.

item.name: Polarized Sunglasses
entries: These sunglasses make the wearer see in bright light as though it were dim light and see in dim light as thought it were darkness.
However the wearer gains advantage to avoid or end effects that apply the {@condition blinded} condition.

item.name: Magnetic Compass
entries: This is a regular compass with a magnetized needle that always points to the magnetic north.
If any effect would distort the reading of the magnetic north, then it would affect this compass. If there is no magnetic north, then the needle of this compass starts constantly spinning.

item.name: Devious Present
entries: This warmly wrapped gift box contains an insidious secret. When a creature opens the gift box, an explosion of glitter fills a 5-foot cube. When you buy the gift box, you can get it modified to trigger with a timer, or explode in a 10ft long, 5ft wide line for twice the price.

Creatures in the area are coated in glitter that reflects any light shed on it and the glitter cannot be made {@condition invisible}. When a source of light envelops an {@condition invisible} creature that is coated in glitter, a sparkly outline of vibrant colors appears around the creature, making it unable to benefit from the {@condition invisible} condition.
Taking a bath removes enough glitter to not be affected by the above effects but small bits of inert glitter always remain on the creatures and cannot be removed by any means.

item.name: Notched Whistle
entries: When you blow this whistle, it emits a high pitched sound that is audible upto 300ft away. This sound can only be heard by beasts and familiars within range.

item.name: Portable Desk
entries: This compact, foldable teakwood desk weighing 25 lbs can be easily set up on a flat surface. The desk can extend upto a 10ft square that is 3 inches thick and can support upto 200 lbs of weight.
The desk is highly resistant to rot, decay, moisture and insects, and it can be folded into a 3ft cube to be carried around.

item.name: Sticky Notes
entries: This notebook contains 100 pieces of paper, each of which can hold upto 25 words.

A piece of paper can be detached from the notebook and stuck on an appropriate surface as it contains adhesive at the area where it was bound to make the notebook. The adhesive wears off after 2 weeks, or after the paper has been stuck and removed from a surface for a total of 20 times.

item.name: Pager
entries: This complex device is made up of magical circuits, created with gold and precious gems, laid inside a solid metal case with a display screen on the outside. Each pager has an unique magical frequency denoted by a 6-digit number that appears when you tap on the screen.

While holding the pager, you can think of a short message containing 5 words at most and it appears on the screen. You can then tap the button labelled 'Send' to enter the number of another pager in the same way and then tap it again to send the message to that pager.

A pager will have a flashing display and a beeping sound that can be heard upto 30ft away when it receives a message from another pager. Tap the 'Read' button on the pager to read any message it has received as it appears on the screen.

A pager has a range of 1000ft and any effect that will block a divination spell will also prevent the pager from sending the message. If a pager fails to send a message, an 'ERROR' message pops up on the screen. Very rarely, you might find a transmitter tower that can help extend the range of a pager.

item.name: Horticulture Biosphere
entries: This 3ft radius, 2-inch thick, transparent, airtight, spherical container that weighs 6 lbs is made with highly thermal and pressure resistant borosilicate glass. The sphere is positioned in a gyrostabilized frame that comes with handles on two sides.

The biosphere is roughly half filled with soil and holding the container makes a digital interface appears on the surface that lets you modify the conditions simulated inside the sphere by touching on them. The conditions include atmosphere, luminosity, temperature, soil nutrition content and moisture level.

Using a manual latch near the handles, you can also open up the upper half of the container and place any flora inside upto the maximum space available. These biospheres are mainly used by herbalists and alchemists to preserve, research, and cultivate different types of plants.

A biosphere consumes one magical gem worth atleast 20gp everyday to keep it powered up for use. If it runs out of power or is turned off using the digital interface then none of its functions work and the conditions inside cannot be modified until it is turned on again.

item.name: Scented Candle
entries: This small candle is made by blending coconut wax with soy wax and infusing them with herbal oils and fragrant flower extracts.
A candle can burn for upto 8 hours. Any creature that finishes a rest while within 10ft of a lit candle gains +2 to passive Perception and Investigation for twice the duration the candle was lit for.

item.name: Bag of Nails
entries: This bag contains 20 nails. When a creature steps on one of the nails, it takes 1 Piercing damage. These nails can be spread on the floor in the same way as {@item Caltrops|XPHB}.
When you buy this item you can choose the shape of the nails.

item.name: Flexible Foam
entries: This flexible polyurethane foam comes in a 35 fl oz aerosol container and when you spray this foam, it will expand and cure within a minute. Once the foam is completely cured it shows a variety of properties such as acoustic insulation, superior compression, extreme flexibility, and high resilience alongside a cushioning effect.
It takes 5 fl oz to make a foam that covers a 5ft cube space, and the material does not decay with time.

Sound cannot pass through an area covered by this foam, and when a creature falls on top of this foam, it takes 1 damage instead of {@dice 1d6} for every 10ft and the foam takes {@dice 1d4} damage for every 10ft instead. Any excess damage is transferred back to the creature. Each 5ft cube of this foam has:

items: 10 AC
25 HP
Resistance to Bludgeoning, Cold, Lightning and Thunder damage
Immunity to Poison, Psychic, and Necrotic damage
Vulnerability to Acid and Fire damage

item.name: Rigid Foam
entries: This rigid polyurethane foam comes in a 35 fl oz aerosol container and when you spray this foam, it will expand and cure within a minute. Once the foam is completely cured it shows a variety of properties such as good dimensional stability, excellent strength to weight ratios, thermal insulation, and high resilience.
It takes 5 fl oz to make a foam that covers a 5ft cube space, and the material does not decay with time.
A 5ft cube of this foam can support upto 300 lbs of weight and can be used to make more complex structures to increase the load capacity. Each 5ft cube of the foam has:

items: 10 AC
25 HP
Resistance to Slashing, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Cold and Fire damage
Immunity to Poison, Psychic, and Necrotic damage
Vulnerability to Acid and Lightning damage

item.name: Vintage Briar Pipe
entries: A beautifully carved wooden pipe that smells faintly of cherries and old books. It is used to smoke various dried herbs and smoking a pipe takes 10 minutes.

A creature that smoked using this pipe can reduce one level of {@condition exhaustion} once per long rest. Every successive smoking reduces the creature's Wisdom score by 1 and does not provide any other benefit. Taking a long rest brings the smoker's Wisdom score back to normal.

item.name: Arcane Power Drill
entries: This power drill appears identical to an electric drill and can be used to drill holes into materials using your desired {@item Drill Bits|HEC}. The drill consumes a magical gem worth at least 10gp to function for 2 hours of continuous use. In a pinch, the drill can be used as an improvised weapon that deals {@dice 1d6} piercing damage on a hit.

The drill is made up of a cordless motor, a chuck that holds the drill bit securely, a variable-speed trigger, a gearbox with clutch to adjust the speed and torque of the drill, a gemslot to hold magical gems that are gradually consumed to power the drill, a rocker switch that changes the drill's rotation direction between forwards and backwards, an ergonomically designed shaft with textured grip and an auxiliary handle for better stability.

item.name: Drill Bits
entries: When you purchase this pack, you get one of the following drill bits in a leather roll and it is commonly used with an {@item Arcane Power Drill|HEC}. You can purchase this pack multiple times to get more drill bits.

Auger Drill Bits: Mainly used for drilling into wooden objects and structures. If you have proficiency with {@item Carpenter's Tools|XPHB}, you get advantage on checks to work on the listed materials and while drilling you do not cause damage to the object's structural integrity.

Masonry Drill Bits: Mainly used for drilling into brick, concrete, and stone. If you have proficiency with {@item Mason's Tools|XPHB}, you get advantage on checks to work on the listed materials and while drilling you do not cause damage to the object's structural integrity.

HSS Drill Bits (short for High Speed Steel): Mainly used for drilling into steel, cast iron, and alloyed or non-alloyed metals. If you have proficiency with {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}, you get advantage on checks to work on the listed materials and while drilling you do not cause damage to the object's structural integrity.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Steadfast Grip
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This leather tassel wraps securely around the hilt of a weapon. While wielding the attached weapon, you cannot be disarmed of it against your will.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Flash Recall
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This small, magnetized runestone hangs from the weapon's pommel. If the attached weapon is on the same Plane of Existence, you can use a bonus action to summon it instantly to your hand.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Rewinding Sigil
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This charm is a small metallic disc. When you throw the attached weapon, it reappears in your hand the instant after it hits or misses a target.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Power Stance
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.

This charm looks like a silver feather. If the attached weapon is a melee weapon that has the Two-Handed property, the wielder ignores the Two-Handed property for this weapon while wielding another weapon with the other hand.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Resplendent Orb
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.

This charm is a small crystal orb. While holding the attached weapon, you can use a bonus action to make the weapon shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. You can change the color of the light or extinguish it as a bonus action.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Savage Strikes
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This charm resembles a jagged shark tooth. Once per turn, when you roll damage for a hit with the attached weapon, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and you must use the new rolls.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Magical Conduit
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.

This charm is a loop of wire strung with beads that have arcane runes inscribed in them. The wielder can use the attached weapon as a spellcasting focus for their spells. Additionally while holding this weapon, the wielder knows the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Colossus Rage
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This charm is a miniature iron hammer. Attacks made with the attached weapon deal double damage to objects.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Sanguine Hunger
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.
This charm is a vial of red liquid that never dries. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with the attached weapon, you gain temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d12} + your proficiency bonus.

item.name: Weapon Charm: Aegis
entries: A weapon (including magical weapons) can only have one charm attached at a time. Attaching or removing a charm requires 1 hour of work that can be done during a rest.

This charm is a tiny shield made of polished steel. When you take damage while wielding the attached weapon, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage by a roll of the attached weapon's base damage dice.

item.name: Aether-Snap Polaroid
entries: This compact, rectangular device has a protruding glass lens, an automatic flash system, a slot for inserting {@item Photosensitive Film|HEC} at the bottom, a shutter button and a small hopper on the side for inserting for inserting a magical gemstone.

As an action, aim the camera at the target you want to capture and press the shutter button to take a photo. Subjects within 60ft of the camera appear clearly on the photo film and those that are 60ft or beyond appear in increasingly lower definition the further they are from the camera.

The camera emits a brief flash of magical light and a sheet of {@item Photosensitive Film|HEC} (which must be loaded beforehand) slides out from the bottom-front. The image on the film slowly manifests over the course of 10 minutes and the image is a perfect, still capture of what the lens saw.

The camera requires a gemstone to function and the gemstone is slowly consumed as the camera is used. The quality of the gemstone also determines the type of image captured in the film. A {@b 10gp gemstone} powers the camera for 10 photos and produces Black & White images. A {@b 50gp gemstone} powers the camera for 20 photos and produces Vivid Color images.

item.name: Photosensitive Film
entries: A pack containing 10 sheets of thick, chemically treated paper used in an {@item Aether-Snap Polaroid|HEC}.
If exposed to direct sunlight before being used in the camera, the paper turns black and is ruined.

item.name: Multi-tool Pocketknife
entries: Popularly known as the {@b Swiss Army Knife} or {@b Offiziersmesser}, this device contains a drop-point blade, screwdriver, nail file, bottle opener, can opener, awl, scissors, saw blade and a corkscrew. Since the device was made with the intention to be compact and easy to carry around, all of its components are quite small in size and the entire device is just about 4 inches long.

item.name: Omni-Directional Mobility Gear
entries: This complex harness is equipped with waist-mounted grapples, two spools of high tensile strength steel wires that are attached to gas-propelled winches, and holsters for a small or medium sized weapon. It allows for extreme mobility in environments with vertical structures.

The gear has 15 charges representing its gas supply. It regains all charges when you replace the {@item Gas Canister|HEC} as an action. The following is a list of maneuvers you can make by using this gear:

items: As a bonus action, you can expend 1 charge to fire a grapple at a solid surface within 60 feet. To determine wether the grapple hits, make an Acrobatics check against a DC set by the DM. On a failure, the grapple is reeled back to your waist. On a success, you are pulled in a straight line toward that point and this movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

During this movement, you can stop being pulled towards the anchor point and instead use the remaining length of the wire to move or swing around. While you are in the air or swinging, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to move up to half your speed in any direction.

While wearing this gear, you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, but you must end your turn on a horizontal surface or you fall, unless you are anchored by a grapple. If you fall, you can use your reaction to fire a grapple (1 charge) at a surface within range to stop your fall, taking no damage.

The grapple deals {@dice 1d4} damage to the structures it latches onto and with the help of the high tensile strength steel wires it can support upto 200 lbs. If there is a {@item Special Piton|HEC} within range, the grapple can latch onto it without dealing damage and the maximum load it can support becomes the maximum supported by that type of piton.

item.name: Gas Canister
entries: A canister that contains a compressed inert gas mixture that is used to fuel the {@item Omni-Directional Mobility Gear|HEC}.

item.name: Special Piton
entries: When you purchase this item, you get a pack of 10 pitons from one of the following types that you choose:

items: Suction Grip Piton - Can support upto 240lbs and only works on uniform surfaces.
Magnetic Grip Piton - Can support upto 360lbs and only works on magnetic surfaces.

Penetrating Hook Piton - Can support upto 500lbs and works on any non-brittle surfaces but it deals an additional {@dice 1d4} damage to the structures it latches onto and will leave holes in the surfaces.

item.name: Piton Shooter
entries: This gun has a huge chamber that can hold upto 10 pitons and is commonly used to shoot pitons onto surfaces from afar. When you shoot and hit a creature with a piton instead, the creature takes {@dice 1d6} piercing damage.

item.name: Manifold Realms Compass
entries: This compass was created with the intention to adapt and aid during inter-planar travel. While holding this compass, choose a destination in your mind that is on the same plane of existence as you. The destination must be very familiar to you or you must possess an object closely linked to that destination. If you fulfill these conditions, the compass needle points in the direction of the destination and remains so until you leave the current plane of existence. If you do not fulfill the conditions or if the destination is false or if it is protected by effects that would thwart a divination spell, your compass needle starts spinning continuously.

item.name: Scouter
entries: The Scouter is a semi-transparent colored monocle that has an extension that balances around your ear and the monocle itself covers one eye when worn. The Scouter is used to calculate the battle power of a creature by aiming the Scouter at the creature for one full minute without taking any other actions. The commonly used models have an inbuilt system that assigns roughly 500 points for each of the first 20 levels of CR a creature has and 1000 points for each of the next 10 levels of CR from 21-30 CR. A normal human with no powers or training appears with a score of 5 and the strongest of creatures like Deities and Demon Princes appear with a score higher than 20000. Alternatively, the DM can decide the scoring criteria and the score calculated by the Scouter.

When attempting to read creatures with scores of 9000 or higher, there is a chance for the device to overload and explode, causing the wearer to become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} for one minute when the wearer fails a 19 DC Constitution saving throw. The wearer can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns. The chance for the device to overload is determined by rolling a {@dice 1d100} and if you rolled anywhere between 1 and (10 + the CR of the creature) on the {@dice 1d100}, the device overloads and explodes.

item.name: Helm of Malignant Horns
entries: This helm has sharp twisted horns that have traces of dried out blood at their tips. When a creature wearing this helm takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, its Speed increases by 10 feet for that action and its movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.

The creature wearing this helm is able to make a special unarmed strike called {@b Baleful Rush}. When the wearer uses an action to make a {@b Baleful Rush} attack against a creature within 5ft of it, the wearer uses their Strength modifier while following the unarmed strike rule for the attack and damage rolls, and the attack gains an additional {@dice 1d6} damage for every 30ft the wearer has moved in the current turn before making the attack (maximum of {@dice 10d6} additional damage).

item.name: Repair Core
entries: This core is an orb with multiple arcane runes on its surface and it emits a faint rythmic pulse like a heartbeat. A Mechanical Beast Mount can be fitted with this core over the course of 8 hrs and this can be done during a long rest. Once fitted, the core grants the mount additional benefits as listed below:

items: The current and maximum hp of the Mechanical Beast Mount increases by 10 hp for {@b MBM: Warhorse} and 30 hp for {@b MBM: Elephant}. Additonally, the mount regains 5 hp for every hour of rest it takes.

After the mount has failed 3 Death saves and has become irreparable, a creature can use 600gp worth of components to feed to the core and make it reconstruct the mount over the course of 4 hours. Once completed, the mount returns to life with half of its Hit Points without any wounds or missing parts.

While the rider is mounted on it and both are not {@condition incapacitated|XPHB}, the rider can use their Reaction to make the mount succeed on a saving throw that the rider was also subjected to and has succeeded against.

item.name: Mechanical Beast Mount: Horse
entries: The stat block of this mount is the {@creature MBM Warhorse}. This mount does not require food or water, and Barding can be applied to it like any other mounts. This mount can be upgraded when you purchase it to have better movement speed and carrying capacity.
You must pay an additional cost of 200gp to increase the movement speed to 60 ft from base, and 400gp to increase the movement speed to 80 ft from base.
You must pay an additional cost of 100gp to increase the carrying capacity to 440 lbs from base and 200gp to increase the carrying capacity to 560 lbs from base.

item.name: Mechanical Beast Mount: Elephant
entries: The stat block of this mount is the {@creature MBM Elephant}. This mount does not require food or water, and Barding can be applied to it like any other mounts. This mount can be upgraded when you purchase it to have better movement speed and carrying capacity.
You must pay an additional cost of 100gp to increase the movement speed to 40 ft from base, and 200gp to increase the movement speed to 50 ft from base.
You must pay an additional cost of 200gp to increase the carrying capacity to 1860 lbs from base and 400gp to increase the carrying capacity to 2400 lbs from base.

item.name: Diadem of Vainglory
entries: This radiant crown is adorned with invaluable gems and it demands the wearer to proclaim their sovereignty over all that exists. While wearing it your Charisma score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 24), and you are immune to the {@condition Charmed} and {@condition Frightened} conditions.

You can cast the {@spell Command|DRK} spell at it's lowest level without expending a spell slot. When a creature forces you to make a saving throw and you succeed against it, or when a creature misses an attack roll against you, you can cast {@spell Command|DRK} at it as a Reaction as long as it is within sight.

When you regain hit points, you use the highest number possible for each die instead of rolling for them like you normally would. Once until the start of your next turn, you can choose the roll for one die instead of rolling for it and the die must be a {@dice d4}, {@dice d6}, {@dice d8}, {@dice d10}, or {@dice d12} die.

entries.name: Curse of Hubris
entries: You cannot benefit from any spells and features from other creatures. Other creatures also cannot benefit from any of your spells and features. You cannot take the {@action Help|XPHB} action or benefit from it.
Additionally, you cannot willingly retreat from battle.

item.name: Gourmand's Bib
entries: This stained bib carries the odor of many delectable treats and it surreptitiously causes the wearer to have an insatiable appetite. While wearing it your Constitution score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 24), and you are immune to diseases, to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.

Any instantaneous benefit you get from eating or drinking is doubled in potency/effect and any benefit you get from eating or drinking that lasts for a duration is doubled in duration. You also automatically succeed on saving throws against harmful effects from these sources. When you expend your hitdie, you use the highest number possible for each die instead of rolling them like you normally would.

{@b Devour} - As a bonus action, you can feast on the corpse of a creature that has died within the last 24 hrs. You regain hitpoints equal to your level + your Constitution modifier, and you gain one damage resistance or condition immunity that creature possessed until your next Long Rest. You can have atmost one condition immunity and two damage resistances from this feature at a time, and they can be replaced whenever you use {@b Devour} again.

entries.name: Curse of Voracity
entries: Your movement speed is halved and you have disadvantage on {@dice d20} Rolls using Dexterity because of your obese figure. Whenever you use {@b Devour} consecutively within one hour, your size increases by one category and your size increase reverts back by one category after 8 hours and this continues until you become your usual size.

You always feel a pernicious hunger and normal food does nothing to satiate it. You must use {@b Devour} atleast once every 12 hours. For every 12 hrs that pass by without you using {@b Devour}, you gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. All levels of {@condition exhaustion} from this curse are removed when you use {@b Devour} ability and they cannot be reduced by any other means.

item.name: Mantle of Unbridled Ire
entries: This crimson red mantle appears to be burning at it's ends, and it incites the wearer to deliver righteous judgement upon others. While wearing it your Strength score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 26), and you are immune to the {@condition Incapacitated} condition. Your critical hit range for weapon attacks increases by 1.

When a creature makes an attack roll against you or forces you to roll a saving throw, after that action is resolved, you can make one weapon attack against that creature if it is within range. When you reduce a creature to 0 hitpoints, you get temporary hitpoints equal to your Strength modifier + your level, and you can immediately take one additional action during the current turn.

entries.name: Curse of Bloodthirst
entries: In combat, when you end a turn while having dealt less than 50 damage, you take {@dice 4d6} Psychic damage that cannot be reduced by any means. When you take damage from other creatures, you must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw and on a failure, you enter the {@b Berserk} state. Your {@b Berserk} state ends only when there are no creatures alive within sight.

While {@b Berserk}, you have disadvantage on {@dice d20} Rolls using Wisdom, and you cannot take the {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB} or {@action Hide|XPHB} actions. While {@b Berserk}, you cannot distinguish between friend or foe, and you must use your action on each of your turns to attack the creature nearest to you.

item.name: Onerous Sabatons
entries: These dull, heavy iron boots seem to almost fuse with the ground, and they assure the wearer that inaction is always the best course of action. While wearing it your Wisdom score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 24), and you cannot be knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}, teleported, or moved against your will.

You gain resistance to all damage types at the start of your turn, if you haven't moved since the start of your previous turn. You regain hitpoints equal to your level at the start of your turn, if you haven't made an attack roll or cast a spell since the start of your previous turn.

An allied creature that is atleast one size smaller than you can take cover (discuss with DM to decide if it is Half, Three-Fourths or Full cover) by positioning itself so that you are between that allied creature and the hostile creature. You can provide this cover to as many allied creatures as your size, space, and orientation allows you to do so.

entries.name: Curse of Torpor
entries: You cannot take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action or Reactions. While wearing the Sabatons your movement speed is fixed at 15 ft and it cannot be changed by any means. In combat, you are always last in the Initiative order (treat your initiative total as 0 or lower if necessary). If you make more than one attack, or cast more than one spell in a turn, you must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for one minute.,

item.name: Raiment of the Alluring Paramour
entries: This revealing, red silk dress with black accents exudes an intoxicating mix of spice and floral scent, and it sways the wearer into embracing a lascivious life. While wearing it you are immune to the {@condition Charmed} condition, and you gain a bonus to your AC and Saving Throws equal to the number of creatures you have {@condition Charmed} at that time, upto a maximum bonus of 5.

A creature cannot gain advantage on saving throws against your Enchantment spells. When you deal damage or take damage for the first time on a turn, you gain a charge of {@b Excitement}. {@b Excitement} charges have no limit but a charge expires 1 minute after you obtain it.

{@b Enamour} - As a bonus action, you can expend 2 {@b Excitement} charges for each creature within 120ft of you that is also {@condition Charmed} by you, to use their reaction to make one weapon attack or cast one cantrip against a creature that you designate as the target.

{@b Euphoria} - As an action, you can expend 5 {@b Excitement} charges to target upto 2 of creatures within 120ft of you to make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw, and on a failure, be {@condition incapacitated} until the start of your next turn, as a result of feeling intense waves of pleasure.

entries.name: Curse of Prurience
entries: Creatures {@condition Charmed} by you are hostile to each other as they compete fiercely for your attention. When you reach 10 {@b Excitement} charges, you lose all charges and enter {@b Euphoria} state yourself. You are {@condition incapacitated} until the end of your next turn and all creatures have advantage on attacks against you for the same duration.

Pain and pleasure have no difference to you. When a creature critically hits you, the mindnumbing pleasure makes you surrender yourself, as you lose the AC and Saving Throw bonus from having {@condition Charmed} creatures, until the end of your next turn. Being in compromising positions only arouses you. When you are grappled, you are also {@condition restrained} for the duration of the grapple and you cannot willing escape or take any action to end it.

item.name: Gloves of the Covetous Scoundrel
entries: These unassuming black gloves have green embroidery surrounding an emerald placed in the upper middle section. Only the wearer can see the illusory snakes that appear from the emerald and hear their whispers of how unfair it is that others get to enjoy the things the wearer is more deserving of. While wearing it your Intelligence score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 24).

When a creature within 60ft rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} Roll, you gain advantage on your next {@dice d20} Roll as you relish in their failure. Once until the start of your next turn, when a creature rolls a 20 on an attack roll against you or on a saving throw against an effect caused by you or on a contested ability check against you, you can force the creature to reroll and use the new result.

When a creature you can see uses a class, subclass or race feature, you can use your Reaction to copy that ability. You can use that ability once within the next minute and you can only store one ability at a time. When you and an ally are targeted by the same attack or forced to roll the same saving throw simultaneously, you can use your reaction to steal all the bonuses they get (ally loses all the bonuses for that instance) and use it for yourself instead.

entries.name: Curse of Jealousy
entries: Your Insight checks have a -10 penalty and your Charisma score is set to 1 (cannot be changed unless your attunement to this item is broken with {@spell Remove Curse} or similar magic). Other creatures can vaguely sense your wretched nature when they interact with you and they will never fully trust you, even if they choose to work with you. An allied creature targeted by you with this item's abilities, can become hostile to you.
When a creature other than you rolls a 20 on the {@dice d20}, you take 20 Psychic damage that cannot be reduced by any means.

item.name: Aureate Ring
entries: This gilded ring has a large head that is adorned with invaluable gems of all kinds, and it tempts the wearer into amassing all the riches in the world. While wearing it your Dexterity score increases by 4 (to a maximum of 24), and you gain a +10 bonus to Perception and Investigation checks.

Once until the start of your next turn, when you deal damage to a creature, you can deal an extra {@dice 1d6} Force damage for each item you are attuned to. As a Reaction when you take damage from a creature, you can reduce the damage you take by {@dice 2d6} for each item you are attuned to.

{@b Minor Midas Touch:} As an action, you can touch a non-magical object that fits within a 5-foot cube and transform it permanently into solid gold, or a pile of gold pieces that amount to the object's value (the DM decides the value if it is unclear). Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Curse of Avarice
entries: Your body has now transformed into one made up of rare minerals and precious metals instead. As a result, you have disadvantage on {@dice d20} Rolls using Strength. You cannot gain Swim speed and you sink in liquids without external support. You are also simultaneously considered as both a creature and an object (metallic object to be precise).

At the end of your long rest, your Constitution score is set to 0, and you must spend 100gp to increase your Constitution score by 5. You can keep spending up until you reach your original Constitution score. Any healing spells cast on you have their effectiveness halved unless the caster consumes 10gp as a component for the spell.

item.name: Gas Powered Fire Whip
entries: This unconventional whip is made of carbon fibre mixed with fire retardant resin, and it is perforated on the surface while containing an inner channel along the length. Inflammable gas is disharged through the channel into the holes, to make each of them burn like a stove and scorch the targets hit by the whip. The handle of the whip is connected to the inner channel and the handle is also larger than usual while being hollow inside, in order to store inflammable gas. To protect the wielder from the flames, the entire handle is thermally insulated and the holes on the whip near the handle are angled away from the handle to prevent the wielder from getting scorched as well. Magical enchantments are used to prevent any issues that arise because of the laws of thermodynamics.

As a Bonus action, you make the whip start burning by using the fuel stored in the handle. During this state, the whip deals an extra {@dice 2d6} Fire damage to the target you hit and creatures or objects within 5ft of it. The handle holds enough fuel to have the whip remain burning for 10 minutes. The whip automatically regains all the fuel at the end of a long rest, but it can also be refilled using a {@item Fuel Container|HEC} as an action.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic whip.

item.name: Fuel Container
entries: A container that is filled with a compressed inflammable gas mixture that can used to refill the {@item Gas Powered Fire Whip|HEC}.

Alternatively, a container can be tampered with and set on fire to cause an explosion. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the container makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 6d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: +2 Studded Leather Armor of Acid Resistance
entries: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
You have resistance to acid damage while you wear this armor.
{@note Worn by {@creature Scanlan Shorthalt|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}.}

item.name: +2 Studded White Dragon Leather Armor of Cold Resistance
entries: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
You have resistance to cold damage while you wear this armor.
{@note Worn by {@creature Vex'ahlia|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}.}

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Agony reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The extra damage when you hit a marked creature increases to {@dice 1d8}.
A marked creature has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws.
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using Agony, you can immediately make an additional melee attack with this weapon as a bonus action.

item.name: Agony (Dormant)
item.reqAttune: by a creature of non-good alignment
entries: Utilized in countless tortures and slow executions, the hooked chains of this brutal weapon constantly show dried blood and rot. Legend says that Agony was wielded in the {@book Calamity|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|1|The Calamity} by the gnoll scion of a flesh-eating Demon Lord.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Agony is in a dormant state, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Whenever you damage a creature with Agony, that creature is marked for 10 minutes or until you damage a different creature. When you hit a creature marked in this way with this weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} piercing damage.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When Agony reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The extra damage when you hit a marked creature increases to {@dice 2d8}.

When you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. On a success, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When the Armor of the Valiant Soul reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.
You have resistance to acid damage while wearing this armor.
You are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition while wearing this armor.
The spell save DC for the armor's {@spell command} spell increases to 16, and the spell can target up to three creatures.

item.name: Armor of the Valiant Soul (Dormant)
entries: This antique armor forged from jade and black dragon scales was once worn by J'mon Sa Ord of {@book Ank'Harel|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Marquet}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While the Armor of the Valiant Soul is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. You can also cast the {@spell command} spell (save {@dc 14}) while attuned to this armor. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When the Armor of the Valiant Soul reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +3.
You are immune to acid damage while wearing this armor.
All friendly creatures within 15 feet of you are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition as long as you are conscious.
The spell save DC of the armor's {@spell command} spell increases to 18, and the spell can target up to five creatures.

item.name: Azuremite
entries: The ruins of this sprawling city are now known as the Crystalfen Caverns. These caves are home to scattered veins of {@item azuremite|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}, a gorgeous blue crystal that formed from millennia of psychic energies existing near element deposits. Curious explorers who discovered the veins found that, when mined and refined into a fine dust, the {@item azuremite|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} powder is a strong mind-altering agent and induces temporary visions and other psychic phenomena.

While a number of small, isolated entrances to this labyrinth of tunnels have been discovered and adventuring parties have attempted to chart the mines, the caverns are so vast and deep that either they gave up for fear of becoming lost, or they were assailed by the terrible denizens of the caverns, never to return. Most who now brave the caverns are foolish treasure hunters or criminals seeking to mine more {@item azuremite|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} to sell on the black market.

item.name: Boots of Haste
entries: While you wear these boots, you can click your heels together to cast the {@spell haste} spell on yourself as a bonus action. You don't suffer from lethargy when the spell ends when cast using these boots. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until next dawn.

item.name: Boots of the Vigilant
entries: While you wear these boots, you can sense impending danger. After you roll initiative, you can choose to roll a {@dice d8} and add it to your initiative roll. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Cabal's Ruin reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects while wearing this cloak.
The cloak has 6 charges and it regains {@dice 1d4 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn.
When you use the cloak to absorb a spell, you gain resistance to one type of damage dealt by the spell (your choice). This resistance then lasts until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Cabal's Ruin (Dormant)
entries: This cloak is made of heavy dark cloth trimmed with golden patterns, and occasionally shimmers with sparks of arcane energy. It was once worn by the famed gunslinger {@creature Percival de Rolo|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Percival Fredrickstein von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III of Whitestone}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Cabal's Ruin is in a dormant state, the cloak has 4 charges and it regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn. When you hit with an attack, you can expend any number of charges from the cloak, with the attack dealing an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage per charge expended. If your attack strikes multiple targets, you choose one target that takes this extra damage.

When you are targeted by an enemy's spell, you can use your reaction to absorb a portion of the spell's energy into the cloak. The spell affects you normally, but the cloak regains a number of charges equal to the level of the spell. This property can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When Cabal's Ruin reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefit:

items: The cloak has 10 charges and it regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Cataclysm Bolts
entries: These steel {@item crossbow bolt|PHB|crossbow bolts} were first created by the Jaggenstrike Clan during the {@book Scattered War|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|1|The Scattered War}, and the secret to crafting them remains well guarded by the {@book Houses of Kraghammer|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Houses of Kraghammer}. Cataclysm bolts are usually kept in sets of ten, though anyone who holds even one can feel it thrumming with magical power. When you hit with an attack using a cataclysm bolt, the attack deals normal damage. Then roll a {@dice d6} on the following table to determine its additional effect.

entries.caption: Cataclysm Bolt Effects
rows: The bolt explodes in a blast of fire, dealing {@damage 3d8} fire damage to the target and each creature within 5 feet of it.

The bolt freezes the air around the target into jagged ice. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d10} cold damage and be {@condition restrained} until the end of your next turn.

The bolt releases a pulse of necrotic energy. The target takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn.
The bolt shatters to unleash a burst of shrapnel. Make six additional ranged attacks against the target, each of which has a {@hit 7} attack bonus and deals {@damage 1d6} piercing damage on a hit.

entries: Once the bolt hits, the enchantment ends and it becomes a normal piece of ammunition.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When the Circlet of Barbed Vision reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to poison damage, and you are immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition.
Your ability to gain a bonus to an attack roll can be used twice between rests.

item.name: Circlet of Barbed Vision (Dormant)
item.reqAttune: by a creature of non-good alignment
entries: When you don this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power to you as the circlet twists your appearance to amuse {@deity The Spider Queen|Exandria|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}. The current resting place of the Circlet of Barbed Vision is unknown, but rumor has it that a spectral assassin known as {@creature Jourrael, the Caedogeist|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|the Inevitable End} seeks this relic.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While the Circlet of Barbed Vision is in a dormant state, you have advantage on initiative rolls while you wear it, but your Charisma score decreases by 2. Your Charisma score returns to normal if you remove the circlet, but you take {@damage 4d6} psychic damage when you do so.

Additionally, when you make an attack roll, you can use your reaction to gain a +5 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the GM says whether the attack hits or misses. You can't use this property again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When the Circlet of Barbed Vision reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: You are immune to poison damage.
You have {@sense truesight} out to a range of 60 feet.
Your ability to gain a bonus to an attack roll can be used three times between rests.

item.name: Circlet of Wisdom
entries: {@note Worn by {@creature Keyleth, Voice of the Tempest|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}, increases her Wisdom score by +2.}

item.name: Coat of the Crest
entries: This exquisite brocade coat is cut in a long, high-collared style popular among nobles of the Clovis Concord—a nation on the west coast of {@book Wildemount|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Wildemount} whose stylish fashion is often mimicked in Tal'Dorei. Its shimmering lining hints at its magical properties. You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this coat, which can be worn over light armor.

Additionally, the coat has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. When you are the target of an attack while wearing this coat, you can spend 1 charge as a reaction to gain resistance to one type of damage from the triggering attack. This resistance is effective against the triggering attack and lasts until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Condemner reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The extra poison damage dealt by the weapon increases to {@dice 1d6}.
You gain an additional effect that can be triggered in place of dealing damage when you hit with an attack:
You cast {@spell hold person} on the target (save {@dc 15}).
This effect can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

item.name: Condemner (Dormant)
entries: This shadow-touched {@item heavy crossbow|phb} once served as the weapon of choice for the legendary assassin Todora. Though few know this, Condemner is now in the possession of an equally infamous assassin named {@book Ixrattu Khar|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|2|Ixrattu Khar}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: When Condemner is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} poison damage.
Additionally, if you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can activate one of the following effects instead of dealing damage:

items: You cast {@spell fog cloud} centered on the target's space.
You cast {@spell silence} centered on the target's space.

entries: When an effect is used, it can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When Condemner reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The extra poison damage dealt by the weapon increases to {@damage 1d8}.
The save DC for the weapon's hold person spell increases to 17.
You gain an additional effect that can be triggered in place of damage when you hit with an attack:
You cast the {@spell blight} spell on the target (save {@dc 17}).

entries: This effect can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

item.name: Corecut Dagger
entries: This dark metal blade bends in a wicked, hooked curve. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can spend 1 Hit Die to deal an extra {@damage 3d6} necrotic damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This weapon is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when an {@spell identify} spell is cast on the weapon or you attune to it. Attuning to the dagger curses you until you are targeted by the {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic; disposing of the dagger fails to end the curse. While cursed, whenever you receive magical healing, you must spend 1 Hit Die to regain any hit points. If you spend all your Hit Dice at any point, you die.

item.name: Dagger of Denial
entries: This silver stiletto blade bears intricate grooves that spiral from its tip to its ivory hilt and handle. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

As an action, you can place the point of the blade into any keyhole and seal it shut. A keyhole sealed in this way can't be unlocked until this dagger is placed into that keyhole once more (though a sealed door or container can still be broken, bypassing the lock). Sealing a keyhole unseals any keyholes previously sealed with this weapon.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When the Deathwalker's Ward reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.

While wearing the armor, you have resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or poison. You can change the damage type when you finish a short rest.

item.name: Deathwalker's Ward (Dormant)
entries: This beautiful black leather armor is covered in intricate scrollwork, and has a mantle bearing the black feathers of {@deity The Matron of Ravens|Exandria|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn}. Legends say that it has been worn by a number of that deity's champions over the centuries—most recently, {@creature Champion of Ravens|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|Vax'ildan of Vox Machina}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: When the Deathwalker's Ward is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and you have advantage on death saving throws while wearing the armor.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When the Deathwalker's Ward reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +3.
As a bonus action, you grow large black raven wings that grant you a flying speed of 60 feet and last for 1 hour. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Doublet of Dramatic Demise
entries: This striking satin jacket allows you to make the most of your dying moments. When you drop to 0 hit points while wearing this doublet, you do not fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, you are {@condition incapacitated} and your speed becomes 0, but you can speak and communicate.
You make death saving throws as normal, but if you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20}, you swoon with a loud gasp and die instantly.

item.name: Dynamite
entries: This bundle of explosives can be lit and thrown up to 30 feet as an action. It explodes at the start of your next turn. Creatures and objects within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Earthboard
entries: An earthboard is a slab of granite about three inches thick, nine feet long, and two feet wide, with smooth, tapered ends. However, its mundane appearance belies its unique elemental power, which reduces its weight to 40 pounds while a creature is attuned to it. {@book The Earth Ashari of Terrah|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Terrah} can often be seen with these stone boards upon their backs as they trek into the crags of the {@book Cliffkeep Mountains|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn|3|Cliffkeep Mountains}.
While standing on an earthboard, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your speed increases to 60 feet as the board skims across solid ground (but not liquid surfaces).

If you ramp off a surface of solid earth, you can long jump up to 60 feet. When you end this jump, you can choose to slam into the ground, creating a shockwave. Each creature standing on the ground within 20 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

You have a burrowing speed of 20 feet that allows you to tunnel through earth or solid rock, leaving a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in your wake. As an action, you can increase this burrowing speed to 60 feet until the start of your next turn.
The earthboard always moves with you until you decide to dismount it (no action required).

entries: These benefits last until you end your turn not standing on the earthboard.

item.name: Echo Stone
entries: This dull-blue river stone is soft to the touch, and makes remarkably little sound if dropped. When an echo stone is squeezed as an action, it glows faintly for 1 minute. The stone records all sound made within 15 feet of it while glowing, then repeats that recorded sound at an equal volume once every 5 minutes. This cycle of repetition continues until the stone is squeezed again as an action, which silences it. Squeezing the stone twice in quick succession as an action causes it to play the sounds it has most recently recorded, rather than recording new sounds.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Fenthras reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2. Additionally, when you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} lightning damage.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can declare it a bramble shot. The attack deals an extra {@damage 3d8} piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or become {@condition restrained} by steely brambles that burst from the arrow. A {@condition restrained} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

item.name: Fenthras (Dormant)
entries: This gorgeous {@item longbow|phb} made of everbark from the Fey Realm flexes and shifts like a living entity. It is said to have been wielded by the legendary ranger {@creature Vex'ahlia|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} against great evils.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Fenthras is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

When you make an attack with Fenthras, you can declare it an oracle shot, allowing you to experience the area around the arrow using your normal senses for 10 minutes. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

Additionally, when a creature is killed by an attack using this weapon, a six-foot-tall tree rapidly grows out of the corpse over the next minute. The tree is rooted in the ground to make the body difficult to move, but does not permanently damage the corpse or its organs.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When Fenthras reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The extra lightning damage dealt by attacks using the bow increases to {@damage 1d6}.
You can declare a bramble shot twice between rests, and the saving throw DC increases to 17.

item.name: Flamefriend Lantern
entries: This wrought-iron lantern holds a small fire elemental spirit. To attune to this item, you must also succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma check to bond with the spirit inside the lantern.

entries.name: Light and Flame
entries: While attuned to the lantern, you can verbally ask the elemental to glow (no action required), causing the lantern to cast bright light in a radius of your choice up to 60 feet and dim light for the same distance beyond that. You can also cast the {@spell produce flame} cantrip from the lantern at will. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries.name: Elemental Essence
entries: The fire elemental spirit in the lantern can grant you a small fragment of its power. As an action, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice for 1 hour:

items: You have resistance to fire damage.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

You can cast the {@spell burning hands} spell (spell save {@dc 15}) from the lantern at 3rd level. Once you cast the spell, you can't do so again until the next time you use this property of the lantern.

entries: Once the elemental has shared its power with you in this way, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Willful Attunement
entries: Your attunement to the lantern lasts until you choose to end it, or until you anger the elemental (by dousing the lantern in water, attacking another nonhostile elemental being, and so forth). You can attempt to attune to the lantern again and repeat the check to bond with the elemental during a short or long rest, but you make this check with disadvantage until you have made amends to the spirit, as the GM determines.

item.name: Gluebomb
entries: This unique explosive can be primed and thrown up to 30 feet as an action. It explodes on impact. Creatures within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. A {@condition restrained} creature can make a {@dc 12} Strength check as an action, escaping on a success.

item.name: Graz'tchar, the Decadent End
entries: This blade appears to be a beautiful cruciform sword of shining silver, inlaid with sparkling rubies. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which has the following properties.

entries.name: Corrosive Submission
entries: When you hit a creature that has an Intelligence score of 4 or higher with an attack using this sword, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d6} acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour. If you attack the creature again while it is {@condition charmed} in this way, the extra acid damage increases to {@dice 10d6} and the {@condition charmed} condition ends. If the target succeeds on its saving throw or the charm ends for it, it can't be {@condition charmed} again in this way for 24 hours.

entries.name: Hidden Nature
entries: The acid damage dealt by this greatsword appears to be radiant damage to all who perceive it. A {@spell true seeing} spell or similar magic reveals that the sword is actually a rusted, pitted blade dripping with acid.

entries.name: Sentience
